ab:
Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a Moonlight Shadow with each Basic Attack that deals 30 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing 10-35 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4 seconds. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

*Cooldown starts upon casting.
*This skill cannot be cast again until its duration ends.

Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270-420 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40-105 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2 seconds or until she launches an attack.
Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.
*"Attacks" that end the duration of Moon Blessing only refer to Miya's basic attacks and her non-ultimate skill casts.
Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a Minion or Creep, and 20% Max HP after killing a hero.

Balmond charges to the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing 150-275 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly, and will have their Movement Speed reduced by 40% and Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 3 seconds.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed that decays over time and spins his axe for 3 seconds, dealing 25-100 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+2% Extra HP) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy will deal 8.5% increased damage (up to 68%).
The Physical Attack bonus portion of the damage can Crit.

*Cyclone Sweep can only be cancelled by using his other skills. (added Patch Notes 1.7.82)
*Cyclone Sweep cannot be interrupted by Crowd Control. (added Patch Notes 1.8.44)

Balmond unleashes a huge strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+target's 30%-45% Lost HP) True Damage. 
 This skill only deals up to 1000–2000 damage to non-hero units.
*Does not show an area of effect pre-animation with Savage Pointguard skin.
Saber's attacks reduce enemies' Physical Defense by 3–8 for 5 seconds on hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

*"Attacks" that reduces physical defense only refer to Saber's basic attack and skill damage.
*Defense reduction can only be applied to non-minion enemies.
*The defense reduction is immediately applied to the first attack dealt.
*Unlike most level-based scaling, Saber's passive value does not depend on a formula. It will simply increase by 1 when a certain level is reached.

Saber shoots out 5 swords that orbit around him, dealing 80-105 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies
on contact. After orbiting around Saber for roughly 5 seconds, the swords will fly back to Saber.
Within the duration of this skill, when Saber deals damage with his Basic Attacks or skills, he will send an orbiting sword towards the target, dealing 210-260 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the main target and 50% of the damage to other targets it passes through and reducing the cooldown of Charge by 1 second. It deals only 50% damage to all non-hero enemies such as minions and creeps.

*When attacking a turret, Saber will still shoot a sword toward it and reduce Charge's cooldown, but will not deal damage to it.
*Saber can cast Orbiting Swords during dashes and in motion using joystick. (Patch Notes 1.6.84). In order to cast Orbiting Swords during Triple Sweep, input must be quickly made during the initial dash. Saber will be rendered unable to cast Orbiting Swords after knocking up an enemy.
*The shooting swords' extra damage will prioritize targets in this order: Visible main target → Visible enemy heroes → Invisible main target. Some situations such as using Triple Sweep on a target inside bush while Saber himself is outside of the bush (therefore making the main target concealed) and an enemy appears on the screen, will cause the shooting swords to home in on latter enemy instead. Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75-150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way while enhancing his next Basic Attack. Saber can dash to the target, and his enhanced Basic Attack deals 75-150 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1 second.

*Despite its name, "Charge" is technically a blink skill, therefore it can go through obstacles.
*The enhanced basic attack has a range of 2.5.
*There is a bug where, if the enhanced basic attack is triggered but somehow fails to land, the enhanced basic attack will still be consumed.

Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2 seconds and striking them 3 times over the duration. The first two strikes deal 120-180 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third strike deals 240-360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

*If Saber is killed during Triple Sweep's duration, the enemy will stay airborne, but no further damage will be dealt.
*Saber's and the enemy target's camera height increases within the skill's duration.
*If Triple Sweep fails to land due to certain circumstances (such as invincibility or enemy's death), Saber will abruptly stop executing the skill and the skill will start on cooldown.
*After Saber knocks up an enemy, Triple Sweep can only be interrupted by suppressed. However, the initial dash Saber makes is considered a blink, therefore rendering it vulnerable to be cancelled by knockback and airborne if Saber was hit before he could reach the enemy. Due to this, Triple Sweep is also unusable when affected by root and immobilize.
**As the blink is considered a separate phase, activating Winter Crown during it will halt Saber in place and cancel the knock-up part entirely.

When Alice's skills hit, she gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson, lasting 4 seconds. Once Crimson reaches 2 stacks, Blood Banquet activates, dealing 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) plus 0.5%~2.5% of the target's Max HP (scales with level) as Magic Damage to nearby units (hitting heroes with skills refreshes the duration) and recovering 10 (+3% Extra HP) HP for Alice every 0.5 seconds. 
 While Blood Banquet is active, Alice gains 8% Movement Speed. Blood Banquet can deal up to 70(+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage to creeps.

Alice fires blood energy forward, dealing 100-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Before the blood energy dissipates, this skill can be cast again to activate Scarlet Shadow, allowing Alice to blink to the blood energy's location.

*Crimson Gleam's cooldown starts after the stream disappears or is casted again.
*Player can hold the skill button to locate the blood sphere.

Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350-550 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1 second. If Blood Banquet is active at this time, it also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of Blood Banquet's damage and healing Alice for the same amount.

Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5 seconds, she descends with force, dealing 500-700 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1 second. 
 While charging her Ultimate, Alice can only use Scarlet Shadow

Upon taking fatal damage, Nana removes all debuffs on her and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. She also recovers 10% Max HP over the duration.
Nana can only transform once every 150 seconds and cannot cast skills in the transformed form.

*A visual indicator is shown around Nana when Molina's Gift is ready. (see Patch Notes 1.6.58)
*If Nana has Immortality available, Molina's Gift will trigger first, end does not cancel Yin's My Turn.

Nana hurls her Magical Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals 320-440 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 20% (max reduction of 60%).

Nana summons Molina at the target location. After a short delay. Molina will chase the nearest enemy hero in range for 2.5 seconds. Molina will deal 250-375 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hero it collides with and transform them for 1.5 seconds, and also slow them by 50% and reduce their Magic Defense by 25% for the duration.
If there are no enemy heroes in range, Molina will disappear after 12 seconds.

*Affected enemies are revealed.
*Molina will chase the enemy hero at an exponential rate[how much?] before it disappears.

Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing 440-660 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. 
 Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1 second.

Tigreal gains a stack of Fearless each time he casts a skills or is hit by Basic Attack. After getting 4 stacks, Tigreal will consume all Fearless stacks to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from turrets).
Attacks from Minions do not grant Fearless atacks nor trigger this effect.

*Fearless stacks will completely deplete 6 seconds after Tigreal is unable to maintain it.
*Fully gain stacks from Lord and Turtle damage but not Altar.
*Only gain stack from Implosion after the pull step.

Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer and sends a shockwave forward that erupts 3 times, each time dealing 270-520 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5 seconds.

*The wave travel at the same speed with his Sacred Hammer.
**It is possible for a unit to be hit by multiple waves.

Tigreal charges in a target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.
Used Again: Tigreal can cast this skill again within 4 seconds, dealing 280-380 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 1 second.

*Cooldown starts when the skill is first cast.
*Tigreal can blink by using the battle spell, Flicker, during this skill.
*The knockback will control enemies for the full duration if they do not use CC immune.
**If an enemy is hit by the end of this ability, they will be briefly knockbacked and stunned in position instead.
**Which means the total duration can be reduced by resilience if stunned.
*Death removes the second phase.

Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, stunning and pulling nearby enemies to him for 2 seconds while dealing 600-1000 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects. The second part of the channeling cannot be interrupted except by Suppression.

*Tigreal can blink by using the battle spell, Flicker, during this skill.
*The skill executes in 3 steps.
**Delay step. Tigreal applies a weak pull which doesn't count as knockback. It now applies stun, and it goes into cooldown if cancelled.
**Pull step. Tigreal pulls enemies towards him. It doesn't stun yet, but it immobilizes. When ultimate is cancelled in this step, it goes into cooldown.
**Stun. Tigreal stuns his enemies for 2s while dealing damage.
*Can pull through obstacles. If the enemy does not pass by the obstacle, they will be displaced next to Tigreal at the time of stun.

After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
 Demon Hunter: Alucard deals 110% damage to Creeps.
The range of Pursuit can be increased by Malefic Gun and its passive Malefic Energy.
Alucard jumps to the target area and slashes, dealing 270-370 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345-570 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

Passive: Alucard permanently gains 10%-30% extra Hybrid Lifesteal.
Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10-20. Alucard gains 10-20 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6 seconds. 
Use Again: Alucard releases a powerful shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400-700 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

*Fission Wave goes into cooldown on the first cast.
*Despite the Fission Wave's Active description, Alucard can still gain the buff even if there are no enemies in the target direction during the initial cast.

Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra True Damage equal to 50 plus 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% of their lost HP (up to 2000 True Damage against creeps).
If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5 seconds.

*"Attack," according to the skill description, only refers to Karina's attack from basic attacks and skills.
*Marks applied by basic attacks cannot be stacked by Endless Battle's Unique Passive–Endless Strike.
*Shadow Combo deals up to 10000 True Damage to enemy heroes.
*Shadow Combo marks are invisible on minions.

Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for 3.5 seconds, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100-200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4 seconds).
Karina's Basic Attack within the duration deals 150-255 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slows the target by 45% for 1 second, and is guaranteed critical strike. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state early.

*Enhanced basic attack does not have splash damage.
*Dance of Blades' cooldown will not start when it is still active.
*Karina launches a spinning slash when attacked in melee. This is purely visual.
*The damage reflection effect's cooldown is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
Karina launces a spinning slash, dealing 375-600 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing 350-750 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Mark to them, and leaving a Shadowform behind them. The Shadow Mark and Shadowform both last 5 seconds. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.
Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150-250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

Akai gains a 25 (+5% Total HP) Shield for 4 seconds on each skill cast and can marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills.
Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+5% Total HP) extra Physical Damage to mark enemies.
*The duration and absorption of the shield are refreshed upon skill casting, but they cannot be stacked.

Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the away. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knocks them airborne for 0.5 seconds and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.
Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly adjust his position.
*Despite its description, Headbutt's "charge" is technically a blink.
Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270-420 (+6% Total HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4 seconds, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 200-450 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemies heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.
Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed to 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression and Morph effects.

*When canceling this skill, it does not trigger Tai Chi, but it does count as casting a skill for passives (such "Thunderbolt" from Thunder Belt). 
*Akai can use Heavy Spin again to cancel it 0.5 seconds after the first cast.
*Heavy Spin damage is reduced to 50% when hitting the same target.
*This skill also stuns enemies on each collision.[how long?]
*Entering or leaving Yin's My Turn cancel this ability.

If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force (up to 10 stacks).
Franco will consume all Wasteland Force stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.
*If the stack has been consumed while the passive is active, Franco has to receive damage or the stack won't start accumulating again.
Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400-650 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage dragging them to Franco.

*The hook will pull to Franco's current position, which can be extended or repositioned by Flicker.
*The hook first applies stun, then the pulling effect.
**When the hook hits a target, it plays a different sound and lingers briefly before returning.
**Some abilities providing CC Immune may fail to remove the pulling effect. e.g. Soul Sever, An Eye for An Eye.
*Fully affect invisible and concealed enemies.
Franco lashes out, dealing Physical Damage equal to 300–450 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.
Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
*Ability ends prematurely when being crowd controlled.

Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of Tidal Energy each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal Physical Damage equal to (+95% Total Physical Attack) plus 4 (+0.4× Hero Level) of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.
(Percent damage dealt based on Max HP Damage Cap against Creeps: 200 (+20× Hero Level). (see Patch Notes 1.7.82 Balance Adjustment))

*Bane's enhanced basic attacks deals splash damage around him.
*Stack(s) lasts for 8 seconds. Its timer resets when it is until consumed by Bane's next enhanced Basic Attack.
*Only the (+100% Total Physical Attack) portion of his enhanced basic attack can critically strike.

Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150-350 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and then 150%–200% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10 (+10% Total Magic Power)% for 1 second.
Every 100 Physical Attack that Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.
*Crab Claw Cannon's cooldown reduction is linear to Bane's Total Physical Attack and not stepwise at every 100 points of Total Physical Attack that Bane possesses.

Bane chugs his ale, recovering 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) plus 5-10 (+1.5% Total Magic Power)% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds.
Use Again: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing 140-340 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (scales up to 200% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Every 100 Magic Power Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.

*Ale's cooldown reduction is linear to Bane's Total Magic Power and not stepwise at every 100 points of Total Magic Power that Bane possesses.
*Bane can fully charge the skill for 2.5 seconds, and can overcharge for another 2 seconds.
*Cooldown starts when the skill ends.

Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in a target direction, dealing 700-1100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking them airborne for 0.6 seconds, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3 seconds).
This skill deals 40% of damage to turrets.

*Deadly Catch also applies knockback effect.
*Turrets are not affected by Deadly Catch's item effects.

Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).
Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, dealing 75-150 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, slowing them by 30%, and gaining a 30% decaying Movement Speed boost.
The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground for 3 seconds. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Slide by 1 second.

*Stack(s) lasts for 5 seconds. Its timer resets when consumed by Bruno's next enhanced Basic Attack.
*The Powerball can only be retrieved from the ground for 3 seconds or will disappear otherwise.
*Movement Speed boost is now granted when kicking the Powerball instead of upon dealing damage, and decays over time.
*Powerball can be cast even when affected by control effects (except Silence).
*Casting this skill no longer interrupts Basic Attacks.
Bruno slides in the target direction, briefly stunning enemies along the way for 0.1 seconds, and gaining a Powerball at the end of the dash.

*The default dash direction follows the joystick's direction.
*When Bruno's Powerball begins to bounce back while sliding, it will land near his dash destination.

Bruno kicks an Energy Ball at a target hero, dealing 200-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. It knocks them back to Bruno's maximum attack range, stuns them for 0.5 seconds, and applies a massive decaying slow.
The Energy Ball then bounces among enemy units (up to 10 times), prioritizing enemy heroes. Each bounce deals 100-200 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

*Energy Ball prioritizes bouncing between enemy heroes.
*Physical Defense reduction effect was removed in Patch 2.2.16.

After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.

*Enhanced Basic Attack Range: 7.
*Single-target attack effects such as Azure Blade's Unique Passive - Judgement or Marskman Talent Weakness Finder prioritizes the targeted enemy of this enhanced basic attack.
*The enhanced basic attack can stack multiple Thunder Belt's Unique Passive - Thunderbolt stacks within a single attack.

Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250-400 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.
The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullet will take <nowiki>[</nowiki>11%–16%<nowiki>]</nowiki> damage after the first bullet.

*This skill has reduced foreswing time by 50% and reduced backswing time by 20%. (Patch Notes 1.9.32)
*The 3rd to 5th deal 5% of the initial damage.
*This skill's attacks prioritize enemy heroes the most.

Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140-240 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds.
Succesfuly hitting and enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes in the first enemy hit, dealing 280-400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds.
Clint gains a grenade recharge every 10–5 seconds (up to 3).
*This skill has reduced foreswing time and backswing time by 33%. (Patch Notes 1.9.32)

At regular intervals, Rafaela can use a special skill to instantly resurrect a fallen allied hero after a brief channeling. The resurrected allied hero will respawn at the base and is granted increased Movement Speed.
This skill's cooldown is determined by both its base cooldown and the remaining respawn time of the revived hero. It is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

*The cooldown is increased to 500% of the remaining cooldown of the revived ally.
*Max cooldown is capped at 240 seconds.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with Light of Retribution, dealing them 225-500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 5 seconds will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

*This skill's attacks prioritize enemy heroes the most.
*The skill's stack applies a mark that is only visible to enemy heroes but is invisible from Rafaela's enemies' perspective.
**It counts as a debuff and can be removed by skills such as Purify.

Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, restoring 100-125 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP to nearby allied heroes, plus and additional 150-250 (+45% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. Also increases Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1 seconds.
Every 20 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus, up to 80%.
Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light in the target direction, dealing 460-660 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor for 5 seconds on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within. 
 When hitting targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target. gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1 second. 
 The lightning chain deals 10-20 (+4% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over time and an additional 275-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.

Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10-25 for 1.8 seconds, dealing 300-400 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and stunning them for 1 second. 
 If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the Magic Defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing 600-1000 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing 300-500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. 
 Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing 300-550 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP. 
 Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. 
 If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.
Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250-350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
*Spear Flip is a variation of airborne control effect, with an addition of lifting the enemy over Zilong's back.

Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250-450 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15–30 for 2 seconds. 
 The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.
*Extended Triggering Time: The skill cooldown also resets if a Minion dies within 0.5 seconds Zilong deals damage to them. (see Patch Notes 1.8.08)

Zilong removes all slow Effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35%–55% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5 seconds. For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Furry after every 2 Basic Attacks (instead of the previous 3).
A team will gain higher movement speed boost with more Oriental Fighters in the battlefield.

During fight, Fanny deals 10%–20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed[speed unknown]) and applies a stack of Prey Mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced[amount unknown] if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.[duration unknown]
Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275-525 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2.
Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

*Tornado Strike must be learned to trigger it from Steel Cable.
*"Obstacles" includes: the walls of a map, terrains, summoned constructs (e.g Grock's Guardian's Barrier), turrets, and the border of Yin's domain through My Turn.
*During flight:
**Fanny cannot manually cast the skill Tornado Strike or basic attack.
**The first Tornado Strike from Steel Cable costs energy and the subsequent attacks will not.
**Each Tornado Strike for each Steel Cable cast is limited to one per target. Even though it appears to be an AOE, if Fanny initiates an additional Tornado Strike and opponents who have already received damage intersects with Fanny or the additional Tornado Strike, neither will damage the already damaged opponents. If a Tornado Strike hits more than one opponent, the limit is shared by all of them. i.e. To successfully attack the same target twice while in flight with Tornado Strike, Fa
Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400-650 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Each stack of Prey Mark of the target increases this damage by 30%.
*Casting this skill will make deployed cables retract towards Fanny.
Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 130% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.
*Damage increase only includes damage from basic attacks and skills.

Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can critically strike).
Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3 seconds, and she gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.
*Upon hitting an enemy with this skill, Layla gains 1.6 - (0.2 × Destruction Rush level) Basic Attack Range (1.6 / 1.4 / 1.2 / 1).

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy that explodes on hit, dealing 170-320 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and applying Magic Mark on them for 3 seconds. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100-200 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500-800 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.
Passive: The range of Layla's Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6–1.8 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.
*This skill's actual range is slightly wider than the skill range indicates.[verification needed]

When Minotaur uses a skill, he will gain Motivation for 3 seconds and heal himself for 5 (+1× Hero Level)% of damage dealt by enemy heroes. 
These effects are doubled in Enraged state.

Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 280-355 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will be slowed by 40% while enhancing his Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal (+3% Total HP) extra Physical Damage for 2 seconds.
Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by (+3% Total HP) Physical Damage.

items.passive: Heart Broken: Become immune to allied Cecilion's Moonlit Waltz in this match.

items.name: Resonating Heart
items.passive: Restore: Allow allied Cecilion to use Moonlit Waltz on the user of this equipment.

items.name: Throw Forbidden
items.passive: Heavy Mountain: Become immune to allied Jawhead's Ejector in this match.

items.name: Passive - Dire Hit
items.passive:
Gains Force while moving, gradually increasing Movement Speed (up to 40). Upon reaching 20 stacks, the next hit consumes all stacks to deal extra True Damage based on the number of stacks. 
 When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15 seconds) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

items.name: Passive - Encourage
items.passive:
Grants you and nearby allied heroes 20 extra Hybrid Defense. 
 When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15 seconds) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

items.name: Passive - Favor
items.passive:
Every 15 seconds, your next healing or shield skill recovers 400 extra HP to the lowest-HP allied hero within 5 units (including yourself). Skills that only take effect on yourself cannot trigger this effect. 
 When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15 seconds) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

standard.name: Wilderness Blessing
standard.desc: Movement Speed in the Jungle and River is increased by 10%. This bonus is halved when in combat with enemy heroes, Lord or Turtle.

standard.name: Seasoned Hunter
standard.desc: Damage against Lord and Turtle is increased by 15%. This bonus is halved against regular Creeps and doesn't affect the damage of Retribution.

core.name: Impure Rage
core.desc: Dealing damage with skills deals 4% of target's Max HP extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit. (If the hero does not use Mana, restores 1% HP instead. The extra Adaptive Damage dealt to non-hero units is up to 120. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

core.name: Quantum Charge
core.desc: Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180 HP (scales with level). Cooldown: 10 seconds.

core.name: War Cry
core.desc: After every 3 separate Basic Attacks or skills hit an enemy hero, all damage dealt increases by 8% for 6 seconds. (A single Basic Attack or skill that deals damage multiple times only counts as 1. Cooldown: 6 seconds.)

core.name: Temporal Reign
core.desc: The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4 seconds. This effect is extended by 2 seconds after getting hero kills or assists. (This only applies to the hero themselves. Cooldown: 20 seconds.)

standard.name: Tenacity
standard.desc: When HP is below 50%, Damage Reduction is increased by 5%.

core.name: Concussive Blast
core.desc: After the next Basic Attack, deal 100(+7% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Cooldown: 15s.

standard.name: Rupture
standard.desc: Gain 5 Adaptive Penetration. Gain Physical Penetration if extra Physical Attack is higher than extra Magic Power; otherwise, gain Magic Penetration.

standard.name: Master Assassin
standard.desc: If there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage dealt to them is increased by 7%.

core.name: Killing Spree
core.desc: When damaging heroes below 30% HP, instantly recover 15% of Lost HP and gains 20% Movement Speed. Additional Effect: Reset cooldown upon killing an enemy hero. Duration: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

standard.name: Inspire
standard.desc: Cooldown Reduction is increased by 5% and Mana Regen by 2.

standard.name: Bargain Hunter
standard.desc: Equipment can be purchased at 95% of their base price.

core.name: Lethal Ignition
core.desc: Dealing damage greater than 7% of an enemy hero's Max HP 3 times within 5s will scorch the target for an additional 162-750 Adaptive Damage (scales with level). Cooldown 15 seconds.

standard.name: Festival of Blood
standard.desc: Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 0.5% Spell Vamp, up to 12 stacks.

core.name: Brave Smite
core.desc: Brave Smite: Dealing skill damage to an enemy hero recovers 5% Max HP. CD: 6 seconds.

standard.name: Pull Yourself Together
standard.desc: Cooldowns of Battle Spells and equipment's active skills are reduced by 12% initially. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 1% reduction, up to 8 stacks.

core.name: Focusing Mark
core.desc: After damaging an enemy hero, allied heroes deal 6% more damage to them and gain 10% Movement Speed. Duration: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

standard.name: Fatal
standard.desc: Gain 5% Crit Chance and 5% extra Crit Damage.

standard.name: Weapon Master
standard.desc: Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from equipment, emblem, talents, and skills are increased by 8%.

core.name: Weakness Finder
core.desc: Basic Attacks slow enemies by 50% and reduce their Attack Speed by 30%. Duration: 1 second. Cooldown: 10 seconds (each Basic Attack reduces it bv 1 seconds, down to 3 seconds).

emblem_pool.rule: Any talent can be picked with any emblem set: one tier-1 talent, one tier-2 talent and one core talent. Each set's page lists the talents the MLBB Wiki groups under it. The pros mix them all the time, which only works because the game allows it.

spells.name: Recall
spells.desc: Teleports you back to the base after 5 seconds. Moving or taking damage cancels the effect.
notes: *Default battle spell
*Unavailable in Brawl
*Has customizable effects

spells.name: Healing
notes: *Default battle spell
*Unavailable in Brawl

spells.name: Execute
spells.desc: Deals 100 (+10× Hero Level) (+enemy's 13% Lost HP) True Damage to the designated enemy hero.   This damage ignores shield. If the target is slain by this skill, its cooldown will be reduced by 40%.
notes: *A dying enemy with Immortality available still reduces the cooldown.

spells.name: Retribution
spells.desc: Deals 520 (+80× Hero Level) True Damage to creeps and minions.   Passive: Creep rewards are increased by 60%, and damage taken from creeps is reduced by 50%. Minion rewards are reduced by 70% for the first 5 minutes.   Blessing: Reach 5 creep kills, hero kills, or hero kill assists to level up this skill (the skill decided by the Blessing of the Jungling Footwear purchased). Reaching 15 increases Physical Attack and Magic Power by 15. Flame Retribution: Dealing 100 True Damage and absorbing 35-70 Physical Attack and Magic Power from the target over 3 seconds (scales with level). Ice Retribution: Dealing 100 True Damage and absorbing 41-90 Movement Speed from the target over 3 seconds (scales with level). Bloody Retribution: Deals 100 True Damage and steals HP equal to 250 plus 20% of the caster's Extra HP from the target over 3 seconds (Deals Magic Damage).
notes: *This spell is required for purchasing Jungling Equipment Footwear items now.
**Jungle equipment footwear items will be locked and cannot be purchased if using other spells such as Petrify, Aegis, Purify, Flicker, etc.
**If Jungle equipment footwear items was purchased, can Reduces the EXP & Gold gain from minions by 70% in the first 5 minutes of the match and adds 30 Gold gained from kills or assist.
*Only when total creep kills, hero kills, or hero kill assists reach 5 can Retribution be upgraded. Minion kills are excluded.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.desc: For up to 6 Basic Attack within the next 5 seconds, increase Attack Speed to 1.5 times and the Attack Speed cap to 500%.   The Basic Attacks also ignore 8(+1*Hero Level) of target's Hybrid Defense and restore 60 (+15% Total Physical Attack) (+10% Total Magic Power) HP on hit.
notes: *At max hero level (15), it will ignore a total of 23 Hybrid Defense.
*Inspire's enhanced basic attacks can be consumed via basic attacks, or any skill that is counted as basic attack e.g. Silvanna's Skill 2: Spiral Strangling.
*The enhanced basic attacks are not an Attack Effect, as they are not triggered by Golden Staff's passive. However, Badang's Skill 1: Fist Wind seems to be an exception.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Gains up to 50% extra Movement Speed and slow immunity for 6s. The extra Movement Speed gradually decays after 2s.
notes: *Suppression & Restrained cannot reducing durations.
*Rooted cannot be removed after summoned Royal Guards by Minsitthar's King's Calling.

spells.name: Revitalize
spells.desc: Summons a Healing Spring that restores 2.5% Max HP every 0.5 second for 5 seconds (maximum of 25% Max HP).   Increases the Shield and HP Regen by 25% for allies within the area of effect (this effect is cannot be stacked up).
notes: *Can be used when being controlled.
*Multiple casts fully stack.

spells.name: Aegis
spells.desc: Immediately gains a shield that absorbs 750 (+50× Hero Level) Shield damage for 5 seconds.   The nearby ally with the lowest HP also gains 525 (+35× Hero Level) (+70% Lost HP) Shield.
notes: *Can be used when being controlled.

spells.name: Petrify
spells.desc: Deals 100 (+15× Hero Level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and petrifies them for 0.8s. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 50% for 0.8s afterward.
notes: *Applies high level crowd control effect.

spells.name: Purify
spells.desc: Immediately removes all negative effects.   In the next 1.2 seconds, gains control immunity and 15% Movement Speed.
notes: *Suppression can neither be removed nor blocked during the duration.
*Purify cannot remove or grant immunity to Rooted applied by Royal Guards from Minsitthar's King's Calling.

spells.name: Flameshot
spells.desc: Fires a Flaming Shot in a designated direction, dealing 160 (+60% Total Magic Power)–640 +180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (scales on distance) and slowing the target by 30% for 0.5 second.   Casting the skill knocks back nearby enemies.
notes: *Also reveals enemies hit for 0.5 seconds.

spells.name: Flicker
spells.desc: Moves a certain distance in a designated direction. Then gains 6 (+1× Hero Level) Physical and Magic Defense for 1 second.
notes: *Has the distance of 3.8.
*Treated as blink ability in abilities' description.
**Therefore it is unaffected by Khufra's Bouncing Ball.
*Does not interrupt the cast animation of most abilities.
*This spell can be disabled by Rooted effect and immobilized.

spells.name: Arrival
spells.desc: Teleports to an allied turret (including destroyed turrets), base, or minion after channeling for 3 seconds, gaining 60% movement speed that will decay in 3 seconds. If the channeling is cancelled or interrupted, the cooldown will be reduced by 30 seconds.
notes: *If channeling is cancelled or interrupted, the cooldown will be reduced by 30 seconds.
*The selected allied turret or minion will be temporarily becoming untargetable and immune to all damage while chanting. The selected minion is also immobilized for the duration.
*This spell can be interrupted by Crowd Control effects during chanting.
*Casting this ability on a turret before the first minion will reveal the user for the enemy until the movement speed bonus expires.

spells.name: Vengeance
spells.desc: In the next 3 seconds, each time the hero takes damage deals 40% of the damage taken as Magic Damage to the enemy.   Gains 35% Damage Reduction during the period.
notes: *The reflected damage is not reflected.

current.name: Patch 2.2.16
highlights: Revamped Hero Masha Masha, Wild-oats Fist . Hero Feature: A Berserker who enters the Feral state by breaking the enemy's wound..
Revamped Hero Bruno Bruno, The Protector . Hero Feature: A Marksman who deals massive damage to enemies by continuously kicking powerballs..

heroes.note:
Hero Feature: A Berserker who enters the Feral state by breaking the enemy's wound.

Masha's core gameplay has been revamped. We want her to thrive as a high-skill ceiling Berserker capable of sustained combat, rather than an Assassin limited to split-pushing or burst damage.

changes.name: Primal Pact
changes.text: Masha has 3 HP bars and dies only when the last one is depleted. Masha gains Feral when dealing damage to heroes or creeps. Feral converts to HP when out of combat. Masha leaves a Wound on the enemy when dealing skill damage to them. Attacking again with a Basic Attack from the direction of the Wound will break it, putting Masha into the Feral state. While in the Feral state, her next 3 Basic Attacks become wide-range claw strikes, and she gains massive Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed.

changes.name: Feral Swipe
changes.text: Masha releases energy forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing enemy heroes.

changes.name: Claw Strike
changes.text: Masha dashes in the target direction, unleashing a wide-range claw strike upon reaching max range or colliding with a non-minion enemy unit. This skill's cooldown resets each time she loses a life.

changes.name: Savage Maul
changes.text: Masha charges toward the target hero, dealing Physical Damage and stunning them, while knocking back nearby enemies.

heroes.note:
Hero Feature: A Marksman who deals massive damage to enemies by continuously kicking powerballs.

We've made several optimizations to Bruno. While preserving his core identity, we've improved his controls and made adjustments across his kit. These changes make him a more agile and formidable striker.

changes.name: Volley Shot V3
changes.text:
Controls Optimizations

The landing distance of Powerball now scales with Bruno's Movement Speed.

The Movement Speed boost is now granted when kicking the Powerball instead of upon dealing damage.

The Movement Speed boost now decays over time.

The landing position of Powerball will no longer cross walls.

Powerball can now be cast even when affected by control effects (except Silence).

Powerball now remains on the ground for 3s, up from 2s. Multiple Powerballs can now be retrieved separately.

Fixed an issue where Bruno would occasionally lose a Powerball while performing his two-Powerball combo.

Now casting the skill no longer interrupts Basic Attacks.


Stat Adjustments

Base Damage: 100-225 >> 75-150

Mana Cost: 60-85 >> 50-75

changes.name: Slide
changes.text:
Controls Optimizations 

Adjusted the default direction of dash effects to the joystick's direction.

Now, when Bruno's Powerball begins to bounce back after dealing damage while he is sliding with Flying Tackle, it will tend to land near his dash destination instead of his starting position.


Removed the damage effect. Stun Duration: 0.5s >> 0.1s

Cooldown: 7s at all levels >> 9-7s

Mana Cost: 60 >> 90 


Mechanics Optimizations

Removed Powerball's pullback effect. Bruno now gains a Powerball when his slide ends.


Stat Adjustments

Removed the damage effect. Stun Duration: 0.5s >> 0.1s

Cooldown: 7s at all levels >> 9-7s

Mana Cost: 60 >> 90

changes.name: Worldie V3
changes.text:
Mechanics Optimizations

It now applies a brief stun and a massive decaying slow effect on the first target hit, and no longer reduces Physical Defense.

Optimized the knockback effect on the first target hit. The target will now be knocked back to Bruno's maximum attack range. 

Knockback & Stun Duration: 0.1s >> 0.5s

Energy Ball now prioritizes enemy heroes when bouncing between enemy units.



Stat Adjustments

Cast Range: 5.6 >> 6

First Hit Damage (Base Damage): 

250-450 (+ 83% Total Physical Attack) >> 200-400 (+ 80% Total Physical Attack)

Bounce Damage (Extra Damage): 

150-270 (+ 50% Total Physical Attack) >> 100-200 (+ 40% Total Physical Attack)

heroes.note: Aulus takes too long to ramp up, struggles to finish off enemies, and lacks survivability in extended fights. We're addressing these issues by accelerating his ramp-up, condensing his damage into a shorter window, and improving his HP Regen.

changes.text:
Base Attack Speed: 0.88 >> 1
Physical Attack Growth: 10.5 >> 8
Attack Speed Growth: 2.5% >> 2%

changes.name: Fighting Spirit
changes.text:
After dealing skill damage to a unit, Aulus gains 2s of Enhanced Basic Attacks (up to 4s).
Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing damage to targets in a line and recovering his own HP, while applying a slow effect to them. During this state, his Attack Range and Attack Speed are increased.
Enhanced Basic Attack's HP Regen (Per Hit): 30 (+ 15% Total Physical Attack)

changes.name: The Power of Axe
changes.text:
Removed Effect: The first cast grants Hybrid Lifesteal upon hitting a target.
New Effect: The first cast stuns targets hit for 0.3s.
The second cast can now be used even if the first cast doesn't hit a target.
Cooldown: 7s at all levels >> 10-8s

changes.name: Undying Fury
changes.text:
Base Damage (First 4 Strikes): 150-270 >> 110-270
Base Damage (Last Slash): 450-810 >> 330-810

heroes.note:
Based on your feedback, we've decided to make another round of balance adjustments and gameplay improvements to Argus.

Argus can now trigger Demonic Slash more often and stun enemies with Skill 2. The increased Ultimate damage helps him counterattack or secure kills.

changes.text: Base Movement Speed: 240 >> 260

changes.name: Warmonger
changes.text:
New Effect: Argus gains 30% initial Crit Chance.
Effect Adjustment: Argus's Crit now triggers an additional Demonic Slash instead of dealing extra damage, but can still trigger other critical-hit effects, including those from Berserker's Fury and Windtalker.

changes.name: Meteoric Sword
changes.text:
After a charge, he thrusts his Meteoric Sword, dealing damage and stunning targets hit. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra Attack Speed bonus.
Effect Removed: Meteoric Sword no longer Crits. Its damage now scales with Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
New Effect: Damage now benefits from 40% of Crit Chance and Crit Damage.

changes.name: Eternal Evil
changes.text:
If the Ultimate is not on cooldown and Argus takes fatal damage, the Ultimate automatically triggers death immunity for 4s, but does not deal damage. The Ultimate's damage increases as Argus's HP decreases, by up to 50%, reaching the maximum when his HP falls below 30%.
Base Damage: 150-300 >> 300-600
Damage Bonus: 50% Total Physical Attack >> 180% Extra Physical Attack
Cooldown: 42-35s >> 45s

heroes.note: Exp Lane heroes need to serve as a primary force in early-game skirmishes. Aldous's reliance on Skill 1 stacks for damage forced him to farm passively in the early game, leaving him completely out of sync with the team's pace. To boost his early-game combat capability and income while keeping his core playstyle intact, we've made the following adjustments.

changes.name: Contract: Transform
changes.text:
Gains a shield on the 3rd Basic Attack, Cooldown: 5s >> Gains a shield on the next Basic Attack every 8s.
Base Shield: 500 >> 350
New Effect: Upon gaining a shield, Aldous gains 60% extra Movement Speed for 1s.

changes.name: Contract: Soul Steal
changes.text:
New Effect: Gains 20% Movement Speed when moving toward enemy heroes while the skill is active.
New Effect: Gains 5 stacks of Soul Steal if the attack hits an enemy hero.
Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Siege Minion / Other Non-hero Unit Kill: 10/4 >> 12/5
Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Enemy Hero Kill: 10 >> 12
Soul Steal Stacks Gained on Siege Minion Kills by Nearby Allies: 5 >> 6
Soul Steal Stack Cap: 650 >> 1000
Bonus Damage per Soul Steal Stack: 5 >> 3

changes.name: Contract: Explosion
changes.text:
Removed the Movement Speed boost.
Base Damage: 100-200 >> 200-300
Max Damage: 200-400 >> 400-600

heroes.note: Lukas was slightly weak in the Exp Lane but too strong as a jungler. To make him stronger in the Exp Lane while preserving his jungler playstyle, we've made some adjustments to him.

changes.name: Hero's Resolve
changes.text: Resolve Gained from Attacking Enemies: 2 >> 3.5

changes.name: Flash Combo
changes.text:
Added a fan-shaped hitbox in front of Skill 1 when used in human form with 0 stacks.
Pulverize Base Damage: 220-520 >> 280-580
Spin Damage: 100-200 >> 80-180
HP Regen: 5% of Max HP >> 6% of Max HP

changes.name: Flash Step
changes.text:
Lightning damage after Flash Strike now only triggers once.
Sacred Lightning Damage: 50-100 (+ 25% Physical Attack) >> 110-310 (+ 50% Physical Attack)

changes.name: Unleash the Beast
changes.text: Ultimate's Resolve Regen: 1-2 >> 0.5-2

heroes.note: To make Odette feel more like a graceful dancer, she can now move freely at a slightly reduced speed while casting her Ultimate.

changes.name: Swan Song
changes.text:
Adjustment: The second cast has been removed. Odette can now move freely at a slightly slower speed during her Ultimate.
Removed Effect: Increased the bounce speed and frequency of Passive's sound wave during the Ultimate.

heroes.note: We've noticed that roaming Sun takes too many resources away from his teammates, negatively affecting their experience. We've therefore made targeted adjustments to rein in his roaming build while minimizing the impact on his performance in other lanes.

changes.name: Simian God
changes.text:
To offset the changes to the Doppelganger's cooldown and attributes, we've adjusted some values of Sun's Passive to keep its overall effectiveness unchanged.
HP Regen: 25% of Doppelganger's Physical Attack >> 15% of Doppelganger's Physical Attack
Extra Damage to Creeps: 50 >> 65

changes.name: Endless Variety
changes.text:
The Doppelganger inherits all of Sun's attributes, but the damage it deals is reduced, and it takes extra damage.

Damage Dealt by Doppelganger: 60%

Damage Taken by Doppelganger: 150%

The skill will not enter cooldown while the Doppelganger is present. For balance, we've reduced the skill's base cooldown.

Cooldown: 10-8s >> 6.5-5s

Base Damage: 200-400 >> 280-480

Experience Optimization: Enemy Gold Reward for Killing a Doppelganger: 26 (+ 1.5 * Game Time in minutes) >> 10 (+ 1.0 * Game Time in minutes)

changes.name: Swift Exchange
changes.text:
The Doppelganger inherits all of Sun's attributes, but the damage it deals is reduced, and it takes extra damage.

Damage Dealt by Doppelganger: 60%

Damage Taken by Doppelganger: 150%

The skill will not enter cooldown while the Doppelganger is present.

changes.name: Instantaneous Move
changes.text:
Slow Effect: 20% >> 25%

Base Damage: 270-320 >> 270-300

Cooldown: 6s >> 5s

changes.name: Clone Techniques
changes.text:
Damage Dealt by Doppelganger: 80%-100%

Damage Taken by Doppelganger: 120%

The skill will not enter cooldown while the Doppelganger is present. For balance, we've reduced the skill's base cooldown.

Cooldown: 36-28s >> 32-22s

heroes.note: Improved Marcel's skill synergy with other heroes, allowing him to work better with a wider range of heroes. As a balance adjustment, we've slightly reduced his early-game damage and skill cast frequency. Marcel can now interrupt skills that require selecting a target location before dealing damage (e.g., Eudora's Ultimate and Vexana's Skill 2).

changes.name: Tracking Shot
changes.text: Cooldown: 12.5-10s >> 15-12s

changes.name: Golden Hour
changes.text:
Location-targeted skills can now be frozen by "Golden Hour".

Cooldown: 74-62s >> 90-66s

heroes.note: Kalea's damage and survivability as a Fighter-Support have both fallen short this patch, making her one of the weakest supports right now. To address this, we've decided to give her a comprehensive buff so she can truly perform as a Fighter-Support.

changes.name: Surge of Life
changes.text:
The Passive's third Basic Attack will still trigger while Kalea is affected by control effects.

HP Regen: 40 (+ 10% Max HP) (+ 60% Total Magic Power) >> 12% Max HP (+ 80% Total Magic Power)

changes.name: Wavebreaker
changes.text:
Base Damage: 200-350 >> 200-450

Cooldown: 4s >> 3.5s

changes.name: Tsunami Slam
changes.text: Damage Bonus: 80% Physical Attack >> 8% Max HP

heroes.note: Increased Kadita's Movement Speed when roaming to the side lane in the early-to-mid game.

changes.text: Movement Speed: 250 >> 240

changes.name: Thalassophobia V2
changes.text: New Effect: Gains 10% Movement Speed while in the River.

heroes.note: Hylos's previous passive effects were underwhelming, so we've adjusted them to make his growth attributes more consistent.

changes.name: Thickened Blood
changes.text:
Removed Effect: Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana gained from equipment or emblems.

New Effect: Hylos gains 1 extra Max Mana for every 2.5 Extra HP gained.

heroes.note: Slightly increased the hero's early-to-mid-game damage against high-HP units, the speed of killing the EXP Crab in the early game, and sustainability in team fights.

changes.name: Performer's Delight
changes.text: Spell Vamp Per Stack of Delight: 0.75% >> 1.25%

changes.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
changes.text:
Damage Based on Target's HP: 3%-4.5% >> 3.5%-5%

Max Damage Against Creeps: 75-350 >> 100-350

heroes.note: Melissa's Skill 1 provided too much Attack Speed for too long, while Muddles summoned by Skill 2 dealt excessive Basic Attack damage. We've reduced Skill 1's Attack Speed bonus and duration, as well as Muddles' damage transfer ratio and the percentage of Attack Effects inherited.

changes.name: Falling!
changes.text:
Attack Speed Bonus: 50%-75% >> 30%-55%

Duration: 3s >> 2.5s

changes.name: Eyes on You!
changes.text:
Muddles's Damage Transfer: 60% >> 52%

Attack Effect Inheritance Ratio: 80% >> 52% (now matches the Basic Attack damage transfer ratio)

heroes.note: Miya's team fight damage and farming speed in the current patch exceeded expectations. We've fixed an issue where Moonlight Shadow's Split Arrow dealt abnormal damage and incorrectly triggered Attack Effects, and slightly reduced Miya's damage to single targets.

changes.name: Moon Blessing
changes.text: Moonlight Shadow Damage: 30 (+ 25% Total Physical Attack) >> 25 (+ 20% Total Physical Attack)

changes.name: Moon Arrow
changes.text: Fixed an issue where Miya's Split Arrow (Moonlight Shadow) dealt incorrect damage and incorrectly triggered Attack Effects.

heroes.note: Hanabi dealt excessive damage to a single target through consecutive Petal Blade bounces in small-scale team fights. To preserve her single-target poke during the laning phase, we haven't changed her base bounce damage. Instead, we've added a bounce damage falloff: when a Basic Attack or skill bounces repeatedly hits the same target, subsequent bounces deal less damage, limiting her sustained output against a single target within a short time.

changes.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
changes.text: New Effect: When Hanabi's Basic Attack or skill bounces hit the same target repeatedly, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

heroes.note: Yi Sun-shin's overall mobility was too high, so we've increased Skill 1's cooldown to limit his dash frequency.

changes.name: Traceless
changes.text: Cooldown: 12-7s >> 12-9s

heroes.note: Alpha's early-game laning was relatively weak, so we've adjusted his Passive to scale with Total Physical Attack, improving his early- to mid-game performance. We've also optimized Skill 2's Regen mechanics by increasing its base HP recovered per hit and reducing the additional HP recovered per hit, improving its sustain when hitting a single target.

changes.name: Beta, Advance!
changes.text: Laser Damage: 80 (+ 80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 8 * Hero Level) >> 60 (+ 50% Total Physical Attack) (+ 8 * Hero Level)

changes.name: Force Swing
changes.text:
Effect Adjustment: Recover HP for each enemy hit >> Recover HP when hitting an enemy (healing decays by 40% for subsequent enemies hit).
HP Regen per Hit: 40-200 (+ 30% Extra Physical Attack) >> 80-330 (+ 40% Extra Physical Attack)

heroes.note: Improved the feel of controlling the Seimei Umbrella when Kagura repositions in battle.

changes.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
changes.text: New Effect: The Seimei Umbrella's Movement Speed now increases based on the distance traveled per movement.

heroes.note: Slightly increased Edith's initiative and flexibility.

changes.name: Onward
changes.text: New Effect: Edith can now pass through walls when ejecting herself from Phylax.

changes.name: Primal Wrath
changes.text:
New Effect: While inside Phylax, Edith can gain Wrath by dealing skill damage to targets.
New Effect: Gains extra Movement Speed while flying.
New Effect: Edith can now pass through walls when ejecting herself from Phylax.
Removed Effect: Knockback no longer deals damage to nearby enemies.

heroes.note: We aim to increase Karina's Skill 1 usage frequency and improve the effectiveness of her Enhanced Basic Attack.

changes.name: Dance of Blades
changes.text:
Cooldown: 7s at all levels >> 6s at all levels
Enhanced Basic Attack Damage: 150-225 (+ 55% Total Magic Power) >> 160-310 (+ 60% Total Magic Power)

heroes.note: To prevent Paquito from snowballing too quickly and zoning enemies out of lane, we've slightly reduced his early-to-mid-game burst damage.

changes.name: Jab V2
changes.text:
Base Damage: 350-750 >> 300-800
Damage Bonus: 230% Total Physical Attack >> 210% Total Physical Attack

heroes.note: Slightly increased Kaja's HP Regen.

changes.name: Ring of Order v2
changes.text:
Cooldown: 7s >> 5.5s
Kaja now gains additional HP Regen equal to 45% of his Total Magic Power.

sections.title: Battlefield Adjustments
sections.text:
===In-Match Economy===
We've found that matches in the current patch are too fast-paced, making it difficult for teams that fall behind to make a comeback. To address this, we've adjusted battlefield gold income and comeback mechanics for disadvantaged teams.

Creep nerf
Reduced the Base Gold of the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle, and Lava Golem by 13%

Team Bounty adjust
Gold Deficit Required to Gain Bonus Gold from Enemy Hero Kills: 2,000 >> 1,500

Minions nerf
Slightly reduced minions' Gold reward growth over time.

===Mythical Honor Battlefield===
 nerf
Reverted skill values to match those outside the Mythical Honor Battlefield.

 buff
Tigreal buff
Cooldown: 16-13s >> 13-10s

===Map Changes Update===
The 2026 Annual Map Change officially begins on 09/28 (Server Time). This update introduces Revealing Wisps, Healing Turtle, and Golden Turret, along with Flying Cloud, which now features an upgraded art visual effect. Once this goes live, you can check out the full details in the in-game Battlefield Overview tab. Here's a quick overview:

Revealing Wisps

Pickable Vision Wisps are available across the map. Upon picking one up, the wisp circles around the hero for several seconds. If there are hidden enemy heroes within a large range, the wisp will move to their location and reveal them for several seconds.

Healing Turtle

Defeating the Turtle no longer grants a shield. Instead, an allied Turtle will spawn on the enemy's strongest lane to help push it. Allied heroes near the allied Turtle will recover HP rapidly and gain Turtle companions to help push turrets.

Golden Turret

Greatly increased the Gold shared to the entire team when any Turret is destroyed. Inner Turret and Base Turret HP are also increased.

Adjusted Turret Interactions for Enhanced Basic Attacks

Hero Enhanced Basic Attacks

All heroes' Enhanced Basic Attacks triggered by their own skills can now hit Turrets and apply their HP Regen effects.

Any exceptions will be clearly noted in the corresponding skill description.

Enhanced Basic Attacks from Sun, Argus, Gusion, Thamuz, Dyrroth, and Masha can now trigger HP Regen effects when attacking Turrets.

Other Enhanced Basic Attacks

Enhanced Basic Attack effects from Emblems, Battle Spells, and Equipment cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.

Quantum Charge

Cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.

When using Inspire to attack Turrets, the Attack Speed boost and defense-ignoring effect still apply, but the HP Regen effect will not trigger.

===Control Settings Update===
We are now factoring in the attacker's Penetration along with the target's Defense and HP to prioritize locking onto the target that is actually the easiest to kill, rather than just the one with the lowest HP.

As a result, in the Targeting Priority options, "Lowest HP" has been optimized to "Lowest Effective HP".

Special Note: Since a large portion of Karina, Karrie, Lesley, and Thamuz's damage is True Damage, they will continue to use the "Lowest HP" targeting rule even when "Lowest Effective HP" is selected.

The original "Closest Target" and "Lowest HP Percent" options remain unchanged. Heroes using these options will not be affected.

===Basic Attack Targeting Optimizations===
We've optimized the targeting mechanics for Basic Attack pursuit, reducing cases where ranged heroes repeatedly switch targets between minions and enemy heroes when pursuing enemies outside their Basic Attack range.

After a Basic Attack hits a hero, tapping the Basic Attack button repeatedly within a short time will now prioritize pursuing and re-attacking that same target, unless a higher-priority enemy hero is within Basic Attack range.

===Movement Control Optimizations===
Added a landing indicator for all dash skills passing through obstacles.

===Sanctum Island Map Updates===
We've fully revamped the art assets for Sanctum Island's scene, lord, and base. The new map now offers better visuals while keeping performance nearly on par with the original. This update takes effect immediately, so please make sure all resources are downloaded before entering the game for the complete experience.

===Simplified Hero Skill Descriptions===
To reduce the length of hero skill descriptions and improve readability, we've replaced some commonly used attributes (Attack, Defense, and Max HP) with simple and intuitive icons.

sections.title: System Adjustments
sections.text:
===New Custom Setups===
To better accommodate player preferences, we've added custom layouts for medium and large buttons in the Custom UI.

===Career Achievements===
Added the [Claim All] feature, allowing you to claim multiple achievement rewards at once.

===Collection - TheMLabel Skin Label===
The brand-new TheMLabel skin label is officially launched.

THE ASPIRANTS series is officially added to TheMLabel.

Complete the full collection achievement to unlock multiple special privileges and showcase your collector status.

You can also switch to the series' customization item overview to plan your collection.

Added the label story feature, allowing you to learn the lore behind the skin series.

===Adjusted Mode Unlock Condition===
We've adjusted the unlock conditions for the following three modes:

1. [VS A.I. & Custom]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Elite rank.

2. [Magic Chess]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Lv.12.

3. [1 VS 1]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Lv.25.

===Multiplayer Training Camp===
Added the Multiplayer Training Camp feature. Access it via [Mode] - [VS A.I. & Custom] - [Multiplayer Training Camp].

===Ranked Mode===
S41 will end at 21:59:59 on 09/15 (Server Time).

S42 will start from 00:00:00 on 09/16 (Server Time). Complete Ranked matches to claim rewards, including S42 Seasonal Skin: Popol and Kupa "Flamehide Thane" and S42 Avatar Border "Starward Decade".

We hope you enjoy the game and wish you the best in your ranked matches!

===Auction House===
1. Added a display status for items marked "Temporarily Sold Out" in the Auction House.

2. Added the Sale Reminder feature. Add an item to your reminder list, and you'll be notified as soon as it becomes available again, provided you're online and not in a match.

3. Adjusted how owned items are prioritized in the Auction House and updated the related purchasing and usage rules.

4. Optimized how the Auction House list refreshes after a purchase.

===Mail Optimizations===
1. Optimized the red dot notification for unread mail. The red dot will now appear only when you have unread important mail or unread mail with attachments.

2. Optimized the display of important system notifications, battlefield reports, and report feedback mail.

3. Optimized the visuals for mail with attachments.

===Namecard===
The Namecard feature has been revamped, giving you more ways to express yourself. Check it out to see what's new!

Tap any player's avatar to view their Namecard and explore its new features.

1. Model / Portrait Display: The new Namecard lets you showcase a 3D model or portrait. 3D models feature an entrance animation that showcases your hero in all their glory. Make your Namecard truly yours!

2. ID Card Customization: Equip multiple ID cards, such as Mythic Medal, Collector, Achievement Hall, Season Info, Live Legend, and personalized info cards. Arrange them freely to show off your best side!

3. Namecard Highlights: Memorable in-game moments—such as earning Legendary or Savage, unlocking skins, and winning tournaments—are automatically added to your Highlights. Other players can give each Highlight a Like or Super Like, and each has its own like count. Show off your best moments!

4. Album Namecard Display: The Album module now supports Namecard display. New content is automatically tagged, so your best moments get seen by other players right away!

===Super Like===
To improve the Like experience, we've made comprehensive upgrades to the Like feature:

1. Super Like: Show your friends some extra appreciation with effects that shine brighter than a standard like!

2. Like Records: Added a new page to your Profile where you can view all your like records in one place. You can also like someone back with a single tap.

3. Like Shop: Earning Super Likes lets you build up currency to redeem skins and exclusive banners in the Super Like Shop!

===Highlights Notification Feature===
Added a new Highlights Notification area, along with exclusive Highlights Notifications that showcase your own unique highlights.

We've also added several new Highlights Notifications to replace some existing ones, along with new hero-exclusive Highlights Notifications. Check them out in your next match!

===In-Match Likes===
We've improved the in-match like experience: the like button now shows which player you're liking, with enhanced notification effects as likes accumulate.

When you trigger certain Highlight Notifications with an ally, you can like each other to activate a series of new teamwork notifications.

===Battle Achievement Interface===
Added a new match result screen showcasing your team's honor. It is currently only shown in Ranked, Classic, and MLBB Rising Open.

We've added a new Supreme Medal to reward players with outstanding in-match performance. Earning MVP will also grant the corresponding Supreme MVP Medal. To balance this, we've also adjusted the requirements for earning other medals accordingly.

We also improved the feedback for likes on the match result screen, making it quicker to like back players who liked you.

===10-Player Match Result Screen===
We now display Highlights Notifications triggered by players during a match, with each displayed icon counting toward the match score.

If there are too many icons, they'll be grouped under a single icon showing the total count. Tap it to view all triggers from the match.

===Protection Points and Star-raising Points===
We've added exclusive Protection Point and Star-raising Point rewards for Supreme Medals.

To balance this change, we've adjusted the Star-raising Points and Protection Points for other medals.

===Season Achievements===
We've added Season Achievement rewards. You can now equip them from the Honor Badge screen, or share your Season Achievement level in the lobby and other screens.

Starting next season, you'll be able to carry over Season Achievement rewards from the previous season, including Style Plates, Namecards, and Honor Badges, until the end of the current season.

We've added new Season Achievement tasks and adjusted the completion requirements for certain levels and tasks, making it easier to progress.

===Announcement System Adjustments===
====[Tab and Content Adjustments]====

The "Announcements" tab will be removed. Important announcements, including patch notees, monthly events, and balance adjustments, will now be moved to the "News" tab.

====[Announcement Notification Update]====
Announcements will no longer use red dot badges, including those carried over to other menu icons. Announcements requiring special attention will instead be marked with a flame icon.

====[Read Announcement Sorting Update]====
Once read, an announcement will automatically move to the bottom of the "News" tab, making unread announcements easier to find.

====[Security Announcement Display Update]====
Security announcements and related content will be temporarily removed. We plan to make them available through other systems in a future patch.

current.designer_note:
In this patch, we've improved several underperforming Jungler and Exp Lane heroes to help them perform better. 

To celebrate MLBB's 10th anniversary, this patch also features a comprehensive art overhaul for several iconic heroes from different regions, including Masha, Bruno, Paquito, Kadita, Clint, Luo Yi, Brody, and Badang. 

We've also revamped and optimized the skill mechanics for Masha and Bruno.
