guides.title: Joy
guides.sub: Dashing on the beat between crystals and enemies, banking Beat Energy, and pulsing through a fight immune to slows
guides.body:
## Hero Overview
Role: Assassin Primary position: Jungle Specialty: Chase / Damage
Joy is a rhythm assassin. Her second skill is a dash she can cast up to four times in a row, as long as each dash hits an enemy or her Leonin Crystal. Casting it on the beat doubles its damage and gives her a shield, and every hit adds Beat Energy that unlocks and powers her ultimate. A Joy who hits the beat glides through a fight, untouchable and hard to pin down. A Joy who misses it is a fragile hero in the middle of the enemy team.
The official ratings in the app give her 9 for difficulty, 7 for offence, 3 for durability and 1 for control.
Why she's picked: for a jungler who chases better than almost anyone, who can dodge skills by dashing through them, and whose ultimate cleanses debuffs and blocks slows when she has full Beat Energy.
What she's weak to: control that stops her before she can chain the dashes, and heroes who punish her for running out of dashes in the middle of a fight. With 3 durability, one missed rhythm can cost her life.
Where she stands right now: in the official rankings for the past 30 days at Mythical Glory and above, Joy has a 0.23% pick rate, a 49.83% win rate and a 0.15% ban rate. She has two recorded games in the app's MPL Season 18 data, both losses.
If you remember one idea from this guide, make it this: every dash needs a target. Place the crystal first, so you always have something to bounce off.
## Kit deep-dive
### Passive: Humph, Joy's Angry!
Each time one of her skills hits a non-minion enemy, Joy becomes Angry, dealing 100 Magic Damage (plus 80% of her total Magic Power) and gaining 60% Movement Speed that decays over 4 seconds. Hitting the Leonin Crystal also grants the speed. The effect has a 4-second cooldown for each target. Her basic attacks deal 65 Magic Damage (plus 65% of her total Physical Attack and 65% of her total Magic Power).
The per-target cooldown means hitting two enemies triggers it twice, and the speed from the crystal means she can trigger the movement boost without any enemy at all.
Practical application:
- Hit different targets when you can. Each one triggers the bonus damage on its own 4-second cooldown.
- Use the crystal for speed before a gank, then dash in with the boost already running.
- Her basic attacks are Magic Damage and scale with both attack stats.
### Skill 1: Look, Leonin Crystal!
Joy summons a Leonin Crystal at the target location, dealing 200 Magic Damage (plus 40% of her total Magic Power) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for her second skill. The cooldown is 4 seconds.
The crystal is the anchor of her combos. It gives her dash a target when no enemy is in line, and its 30% slow helps her next dash land.
Practical application:
- Place it on or beside the enemy, so it damages and slows them and gives you a springboard in the same spot.
- Place it behind a wall to escape: dash to the crystal and keep going.
- It lasts only 2 seconds. Dash to it straight away.
### Skill 2: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 Magic Damage (plus 40% of her total Magic Power) to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal lets her cast it again within 0.8 seconds and gives her 1 Beat Energy. Casting it on the beat doubles the skill damage and gives her a shield of 80 (plus 60% of her total Magic Power) for 3 seconds. It can be cast up to 4 times in a row. The cooldown is 8 seconds.
Each recast must start within 0.8 seconds of the last hit, and on-beat casts are worth twice as much. Four on-beat dashes through the enemy are the core of her damage and her survival.
!! The skill text does not say how the beat is timed or shown on screen. Watch the beat indicator in game and practise it in practice mode.
Practical application:
- Chain all four dashes when you can. Each hit gives Beat Energy for the ultimate.
- Dash through enemies, not just at them. Ending behind a target is often safer than ending in front.
- If you have no target for the next dash, place the crystal first.
### Ultimate: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
Joy gains 15 Physical and Magic Defense (plus 10% of her total Magic Power) and 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 4 seconds, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120 Magic Damage (plus 40% of her total Magic Power) to nearby enemies each time. Each Meow cast on the beat increases the ultimate's damage by 40%. If she hits every beat with Meow, she also gains 40% Spell Vamp while the ultimate is active. The cooldown is 28 seconds.
It only unlocks once she has Beat Energy. Casting it with 3 Beat Energy removes all debuffs on her and makes her immune to slows while it lasts.
!! The skill text does not say whether the 40% damage bonus counts dashes before or during the ultimate. This guide reads it as on-beat dashes while the ultimate is active.
Practical application:
- Build 3 Beat Energy before you cast it, so it cleanses you and blocks slows.
- Keep dashing on the beat during the 4 seconds. Each on-beat dash adds damage, and a perfect rhythm gives 40% Spell Vamp.
- The cleanse makes it an escape too: cast it with 3 Beat Energy to break free from a slow or a debuff.
::curve 2,4,3 | Early: a fast jungler with strong ganks once she has both skills, but fragile. Mid: her chase and burst are at their best against heroes who rotate alone (her peak). Late: still dangerous, but grouped enemies with control make every missed beat costly.
!! The power curve is our reading of the kit, not data.
## How the kit fits together
### Crystal, dash, dash
Her basic engage: place the crystal on the enemy, dash through them, dash to the crystal, dash back through them. Every hit adds Beat Energy, triggers the passive and refreshes the 0.8-second recast window.
### Beat Energy powers the ultimate
The ultimate needs Beat Energy to unlock and needs 3 to cleanse. Dashing first and casting the ultimate after is her standard order.
### Rhythm is the damage
On-beat dashes deal double damage and shield her. During the ultimate, each one adds 40% to the pulses. A perfect rhythm adds 40% Spell Vamp on top. A Joy who practises the beat deals much more damage than one who just dashes.
## Combos
::combo Crystal Bounce | [Look, Leonin Crystal!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] | Place the crystal next to the target, then dash through the target, to the crystal and back through the target.
Sequence: Leonin Crystal → Meow (through target) → Meow (to crystal) → Meow (through target)
The crystal slows the target by 30% and gives you a springboard, so each dash has something to hit and the recast window stays open.
::combo Full Beat | [Look, Leonin Crystal!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > ULT > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] | Build 3 Beat Energy with the crystal bounce, cast the ultimate to cleanse and block slows, then use the last dash on the beat during the pulses.
Sequence: Leonin Crystal → Meow ×3 → Ha, Electrifying Beats! → Meow
With 3 Beat Energy, the ultimate removes debuffs and makes you immune to slows, and the last on-beat dash adds 40% to its damage.
::combo Crystal Escape | [Look, Leonin Crystal!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] > [Meow, Rhythm of Joy!] | Place the crystal away from danger, dash to it, then keep dashing away within the recast window.
Sequence: Leonin Crystal (away) → Meow (to crystal) → Meow
Hitting the crystal grants the passive's 60% Movement Speed, so the escape speeds up after the first dash.
## Builds and emblems
Joy's build should raise her Magic Power, since nearly every number in her kit scales with it, and keep her alive through her dashes.
What the pros did: the app has two recorded Joy games from MPL Season 18, both in MPL ID and both losses. QINN (DEWA) played her on 11 October 2026 (1/1/1, 7226 gold) with Rose Gold Meteor, Tough Boots and Concentrated Energy. Arthur (RRQ) played her on 16 October 2026 (0/3/0, 6709 gold) with Arcane Boots, Concentrated Energy, Genius Wand and smaller components. Concentrated Energy was in both inventories.
!! Two short losses are too small a sample to call a pro build. The builds below are our reading of her kit and item effects, starting from the pro items.
- Concentrated Energy: 75 Magic Power, 400 HP and 20% Hybrid Lifesteal, plus up to 30 more Magic Power and 12% more Magic Damage at full stacks. Her many quick hits build the stacks fast.
- Genius Wand: 75 Magic Power and 10 Magic Penetration, and each hit of Magic Damage lowers the target's Magic Defense.
- Rose Gold Meteor: QINN's choice for survival. Its shield of 120 per hero level and 50% Movement Speed trigger when damage drops her below 30% HP.
### Build 1 — Burst Jungler
::build Burst Jungler | Ice Retribution, Arcane Boots, Concentrated Energy, Genius Wand, Holy Crystal, Divine Glaive | Our template from Arthur's items: Concentrated Energy and Genius Wand first, then Holy Crystal and Divine Glaive for damage and penetration.
!! The app's data has no effect text for the Retribution jungle items, so this guide does not say which one to choose.
### Build 2 — Survival
::build Survival Jungler | Ice Retribution, Tough Boots, Concentrated Energy, Rose Gold Meteor, Genius Wand, Blood Wings | Our adjustment from QINN's items, for drafts with burst and control. Blood Wings adds a shield of 800 (plus 100% of her Magic Power).
### Emblem
::emblem Custom Assassin Emblem | Thrill, Master Assassin, Killing Spree | QINN's setup. Thrill gives 16 Adaptive Attack, and Master Assassin adds 7% damage when only one enemy hero is nearby.
!! The pro record for QINN lists only two talents. Killing Spree as the core talent is our choice: when she damages a hero below 30% HP, it heals 15% of her lost HP and gives 20% Movement Speed.
Arthur used the Mage emblem with Inspire and Festival of Blood; his core talent is not recorded either. Festival of Blood is listed under the Fighter emblem, but any talent can go with any set.
### Battle spells
::spells Retribution | Retribution for the jungle.
## Early game
::map jungle | Jungle: clear with the crystal and the dashes, which hit several monsters at once, and gank as soon as both skills are up.
Joy's skills have short cooldowns: 4 seconds for the crystal and 8 for the dash. Her clear is quick, and her ganks are strong once she can chain the crystal and the dashes.
Before a gank, place the crystal and dash to it on your way. The passive's 60% Movement Speed decays over 4 seconds and gets you to the lane faster.
At level 4, the ultimate makes her ganks deadly: bounce three times for 3 Beat Energy, then cast it to cleanse and pulse.
During the early game, focus on:
- Practising the beat in jungle clears, where mistakes cost nothing.
- Ganking lanes where your allies can hold the target for your first crystal.
- Avoiding fights where the enemy can stop you before you start dashing.
## Mid game: objectives and rotations
::map river | River: hunt enemies who rotate alone. Joy's chase and her passive speed make her hard to escape in the river.
The mid game is where Joy's chase matters most. The official counter lists name her as a counter to Marcel, Bruno, Moskov, Cyclops, Melissa, Brody, Hirara and Ruby. Look for those heroes away from their team.
## Late game and teamfights
In late fights, wait for the enemy to use their control. Then enter with the crystal on their backline and chain the dashes, building 3 Beat Energy before the ultimate.
With the ultimate active, stay on the beat. Each on-beat dash adds 40% to the pulses, and a perfect rhythm gives 40% Spell Vamp to stay alive through the fight.
## Advanced techniques
### 1. Always Have a Springboard
The dash only recasts if it hits an enemy or the crystal. Place the crystal before you need it.
### 2. Cleanse With 3 Beat Energy
Casting the ultimate with 3 Beat Energy removes all debuffs and blocks slows. Use it to break free from a slow aimed at stopping your chase.
### 3. Two Targets, Two Passives
The passive has a 4-second cooldown for each target. Dashing through two enemies triggers it on both.
### 4. Crystal for Speed
Hitting the crystal grants the passive's Movement Speed. Use it to chase, rotate or escape even with no enemy near.
### 5. Perfect Rhythm for Lifesteal
Hitting every beat during the ultimate gives 40% Spell Vamp. It is the difference between surviving a fight and dying in it.
## Matchups and counterplay
::vs good=Marcel,Bruno,Moskov,Cyclops,Melissa,Brody,Hirara,Ruby | bad=Hanabi,Sun,X.Borg,Uranus,Lolita | ally=Atlas,Tigreal,Khufra
### Favorable Conditions
Joy appears on the counter lists of Marcel, Bruno, Moskov, Cyclops, Melissa, Brody, Hirara and Ruby in the official rankings (Mythical Glory and above, past 30 days).
### Difficult Conditions
The official counter list for Joy in the same data is Hanabi, Sun, X.Borg, Uranus and Lolita.
!! The reasons for each counter are not given in the data; the official list only names them.
### Understanding Matchups
The ally list is our reading: Atlas, Tigreal and Khufra hold enemies in place, so Joy's dashes have targets that cannot leave.
!! The ally list is not from a data source.
## Common mistakes
### 1. Dashing Without a Target
A dash that hits nothing ends the chain. Place the crystal first.
### 2. Ultimate With Low Beat Energy
Without 3 Beat Energy, the ultimate does not cleanse or block slows.
### 3. Ignoring the Beat
Off-beat dashes deal half the damage and give no shield.
### 4. Diving Before Enemy Control
With 3 durability, Joy cannot afford to be stunned at the start of her chain.
### 5. Letting the Crystal Expire
It lasts 2 seconds. Dash to it straight away.
## Practice drills
::steps Beat training | In practice mode, place the crystal next to a dummy; dash through the dummy, to the crystal and back; try to hit every beat; repeat until four on-beat dashes in a row feel natural
### 1. Crystal Angles
Practise placing the crystal on, beside and behind targets, and see which angles keep the chain going.
### 2. Ultimate Timing
Practise reaching 3 Beat Energy before casting the ultimate, then keep dashing on the beat during the pulses.
### 3. Escape Routes
Practise placing the crystal across a wall and dashing over it.
### 4. Fight Review
After each game, ask:
- Did my dashes always have a target?
- Did I cast the ultimate with 3 Beat Energy?
- Did I wait for the enemy's control before going in?
## Accuracy and patch notes
This guide uses the skill text in the app's data (MLBB Wiki, fetched November 2026), the official hero rankings for the past 30 days at Mythical Glory and above (updated 9 November 2026), and MLBBHub's MPL Season 18 match records. Skill values can change with balance patches; check the in-game description after each patch.

entries.name: Cinematics, background video and whole splash art
new: Cinematics in More: 174 official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang videos in four tabs: Heroes (76), Skins (50), Collabs (25) and Story (23)
Each tab is grouped with headers: Heroes A to Z by hero, Skins by series, Collabs by collab, Story by story arc, newest first inside every group. Switch to Newest to group by year instead
Search by title, hero, series or year, and filter the Heroes tab by role. Every card shows its thumbnail, length, the hero or series, the role and the year
A playlist player at full width: play and pause, previous, next and shuffle, and the next video starts by itself when one ends

The queue shows under the player in the same order as the list, with the current video highlighted. Tap any video in the queue to jump to it. Play a whole group with its Play button, or everything with Play all or Shuffle

Videos from Cinematics keep playing while you move around the app, in a video mini-player above the nav bar with previous, play and pause, and next. Tap it to go back to Cinematics, or swipe it down to stop
Swipe the music mini-player down to stop the music and hide the bar. A short drag springs back
changed: Starting a Cinematics video pauses the music, and the music bar steps aside while the video plays, so only one plays at a time
Videos you open on a hero's page work as before: they stop when you leave the page
Tap a skin's splash art in the gallery, the skin story, your favorite skins or a hero's Skins tab to open it full screen. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, and the x, a tap or Back closes it
A Cinematics video pauses when the app goes to the background, like the music
fixed: Splash art in the skin gallery, the skin story sheet, your favorite skins and the hero Skins tab is no longer cropped. Each picture now shows whole, at its own shape, with nothing stretched
Back now closes an open skin story sheet before it leaves the page

entries.name: A new profile and a themed skin gallery
new: Profile banner: upload a picture from your phone to sit behind your profile, like a hero's banner. It stays on this phone only. Change or remove it in edit mode
Your avatar now sits in the hero portrait spot over the banner, with your title above your name and your primary and secondary roles as role chips
A details card like the hero Lore tab: current rank, stars, highest rank, highest stars, primary and secondary role, ID, server, title, matches, win rates and likes
Copy your ID with one tap (it copies the server too)
Main heroes: pick up to 5. Each links to its hero page and shows your matches and win rate when you have them. Or fill them from your top heroes
Favorite skins: pick up to 8 from the app's skin list. A downloaded splash shows the art, otherwise a clean placeholder
Edit mode sets every field: name, title, ID, server, roles, matches, likes and win rates, with Save and Cancel
Skin gallery (More > Skin gallery): 866 skins grouped into 66 themes, like story series, collabs, events, esports, StarLight, seasons and skin lines. Filter and search by theme, hero or skin
Each theme shows the series' official story when it has one, with a link to the full story in Lore. Tap a skin for its own story and a link to the hero's skins
Download a theme's splash art with one button. Until then each skin shows a clean placeholder
changed: Tapping a rank still opens the tier and stars picker, and rank icons download the same way
Back while editing leaves edit mode first and asks before throwing away changes. When there is no page to go back to, Back from Profile goes to More
Saving the win rates and heroes form keeps you on Profile instead of going to Home
fixed: Saving the win rates and heroes form erased your ID, server, title, matches and likes. Every save now keeps the rest of your profile
A profile saved without a heroes list (from an older import) no longer leaves the Profile page blank

entries.name: Videos you can see, a seamless comic reader and more

Full-screen button on every playing video. Leaving full screen puts you back at the same spot

changed: Story videos and trailers are wide 16:9 picture cards at full width. Tap one and it plays right inside the card, with a loading picture instead of an empty box

Franco|Blazing Axe: "Kane! Be ready to pay for what you did!"

Brutal and bad-tempered, Franco is the most notorious smuggler in Los Pecados. Once in a fight against Kane, he lost his right arm. To get back at Kane for that, Franco asked the best smith in Los Pecados to make a mechanical arm for him. With his new arm on, he is now waiting for a chance to take his revenge.
Layla|Blazing Gun: "You stupid jerk, Kane! I certainly deserve a higher bounty than that dumb metal guy!"
Estes|Rattan Dragon: To save the world from endless suffering, the Guardian Dragons harnessed their powers once more, sensing the Dragons' Resurgence, with themselves. The powerful Kraken hastened his plan to destroy the world, and dominate his dark reign. Inspired by the Fiery Dragon Warrior, many fine and noble warriors journeyed and entered the Dragon Trials. Among them, was a warrior from an ancient Elven Realm, who made his way to the Dragon Sanctuary, where the final trial of wisdom awaited.
Valir|Draconic Flame: Ages ago, under the protection of the Mighty dragons, our world used to be greatly prosperous and remained at peace. However, all this was before the vicious Kraken and his minions broke through the magical barrier that isolated the Land of Dawn from the external forces of evil. Charging in with his the minion army, Kraken prepared to launch an assault on the entire Land of Dawn. As expected, after these events, everything changed for the worse. To protect the human world, the Guardian Dragons met the Kraken with force and waged an arduous battle against the Kraken and it's the bloodthirsty army. However, little did the people know about the Kraken's secret power, which deprived the Guardian Dragons of their energy and abilities. Ultimately, the battle shifted to Kraken's favor and all the Guardian Dragons grew weak and debilitated. Running out of options, the Guardian Dragons had no choice but to retreat to the Dragon Sanctuary, a place initially constructed by humans, as a safehold for the Guardian Dragons. With what little power they had left, the Guardian Dragons summoned a magical wand, that was strong enough to withstand the Kraken's fearsome attacks. At the same time, they called upon all human warriors, brave enough, to protect the world from evil. Eventually, the first champion who successfully passed through the ward and the Dragon Trials heeded the call from the Great Fiery Dragon. Yet, countless obstacles and difficult challenges await him on the path ahead. Only by facing his deepest fears, can the champion embrace his true destiny.
Selena|Silverbolt Raiko: Created, controlled, and cast aside, Selena still crossed the entire chessboard on her own terms.
She serves no world, and bows to no creator.
Behind this gambit lies a single truth: to reclaim the freedom that is hers.
Kimmy|Frost Wing: While the Guardian Dragons tirelessly fought for the prosperity of the world, the Kraken was equally relentless in his attacks with a final warrior on her way to aid the Guardian Dragons.

The final war that would determine the future of humanity broke out. Freeze and sweep away all the forces of evil in the world with extreme cold. The warrior from Moniyan Empire is all set to engage the evil dragon.
Esmeralda|Blazing Shadow: "Kane, I will destroy you in my own way."
Her mysterious power of divination once made her a valuable supporter to Kane, but somehow they turned against each other.
Ling|Night Shade: A mysterious swordsman from the Cadia Riverlands heard the Dragon's Call. Hearing promises of divine weapons and rewards he devoted all of his energy and time to aid the dragons no matter the cost.
With another courageous warrior accepting the challenges of the Dragon Trials, the Kraken had another fearsome opponent to worry about.
Lukas|Naruto Uzumaki: "みんな! うずまきナルトが、帰ってきたぞ!" (Everyone! Naruto Uzumaki is back!)

Lukas "Naruto Uzumaki" arrives first, bringing his awesome Rasengan combos and powerful Nine-Tails mode that will dominate the Ninja Battlefield. Additionally featuring original anime voice acting by Junko Takeuchi, with mysterious voice interaction Easter eggs for you to discover.
Obsidia|Imperatrix Arashi: "We do not destroy; we merely purge the parasites from the host."
The rise and fall of civilizations, and even Selena's birth, were nothing more than moves on Obsidia's chessboard.
Now, she's about to make her final move in this endgame.
But it seems... fate's chess match has only just begun.
Tigreal|Lightborn - Defender: Awakened from the darkness, they are the last ones adherent to the light. While the Moniyan Empire is on the brink of destruction, will they be able to save the day?
Alucard|Lightborn - Striker: Awakened from the darkness, they are the last ones adherent to the light. While the Moniyan Empire is on the brink of destruction, will they be able to save the day?
Akai|Kung Fu Panda: Akai "Kung Fu Panda", Ling "Lord Shen" and Thamuz "General Kai" has brought their Kung Fu battle to the Land of Dawn! Who's going to be the winner?
Bane|Soul Defiler: He strives to reign over the whole universe. When he raises his arm and points his weapon to the stars, the invincible armada will march through a wormhole to answer to his commands.
Rafaela|S.A.B.E.R. Savior: S.A.B.E.R. - a group of remarkable people with extraordinary powers teamed up as the 'Special Anti Brutality Emergency Response'.
The last member of the squad finally makes her debut. The Savior Rafaela shines the healing light upon the wounded while paralyzing the criminals with almighty magic.
Fanny|Skylark: Searching for the mysterious ancient battle techniques, Fanny once traveled into the mountains of the east.
Layla|The Beacon: Layla, who inherited her navigator father's power, faces the absolutely suppressive Thamuz "The Annihilator". Watch how Layla rallies cross-dimensional forces to save the Nexus Sea in this moment of crisis!
Layla|Prismatic Rhythm: She heard the call of the stars and felt the heartbeat from beyond.
This time, Layla answers the 10th Anniversary's dazzling invitation as "Prismatic Rhythm"!
Natalia|Soul Huntress: The most alluring is the most dangerous, and beautiful things always possess powerful attraction. The closer you get, the more dazzling they become, but little do you know that beneath the stunning exterior hides a dangerous huntress, waiting for prey to step into her trap.
Sun|Wicked Flames: With the Staff in hand, Sun plays the magic of his Clone Techniques to make a surprise attack and eliminate the enemies who stand in his way.
Sun|Celestial Rebel: With every swing, the mechanical staff extends and retracts fluidly, lengthening and shortening at will, as he rides the clouds and charges forward with thunderous force.

r: Ice and snow cover ancient legends, leaving only the harshest living conditions on the surface. Only those with fire in their hearts and an unyielding stubbornness can hope to survive here.
Countless fragments of history lay buried beneath the sand dunes. Unlike Moniyan, the next chapter of this region still waits quietly to be written.

Home to the great plains and the most fertile region of the Land of Dawn. Known in ancient times as the Land of the Gods. Now under the control of the human empire, where countless allegiances and betrayals have played their course.
An island continent that lies across the sea from the main continent of Dawn. A mystical land to the far east that has given rise to many heroic warriors and legendary tales.
The main battlefield between the human empire and the forces of the Abyss. Through baptism by blood and fire, this region has become the harshest and most resilient land in all of Dawn.
The birthplace of the Elves. A magical land blessed by the moonlight. During the Endless War, the forces of darkness corrupted parts of the Azrya Woodlands into a twisted version of its former self.
A giant fissure on the Land of Dawn that is as old as the world itself. The vast darkness here has given rise to countless bizarre creatures.
These tropical waters are dotted with islands containing magnificent civilizations and undiscovered mysteries.

Northern Vale.q: Ice and snow cover ancient legends, leaving only the harshest living conditions on the surface. Only those with fire in their hearts and an unyielding stubbornness can hope to survive here.
in: Northern Vale is a continent of ice and snow, space-time rifts and monsters also spawn within Northern Vale borders but one of the four Guardians of the Land of Dawn, undertakes all those responsibilities of protecting the world, protecting its border and ensuring its safety from the space-time rifts and monsters. It was previously called Nost Gal.

Northern Vale is nothing but a remote and strange name. This place is the coldest spot in the Land of Dawn and also, the northernmost end in human knowledge. Surrounded by the vast Frozen Sea, this place has been full of danger. Therefore, besides the sea lane, Megalith Wasteland has been the only way for people in Northern Vale to get to the other areas in the Land of Dawn.

Except for a few places, the whole of Northern Vale is covered by thick snow. With piercing wind rampant, the harsh weather and its unique disadvantageous location have made this place a fertile land. Life here has been extremely hard and only the most robust Northern Valers, could prosper here from generation to generation.

The harsh weather has forged these tough people. They have regarded courage and honor as the most precious things in this world. In the continuous struggle against nature, people in Northern Vale has created a unique world view and civilization.

pl.t: A giant temple built on ancient ruins that houses the glory of the Valkyries.
Lined with dangerous shipping lanes full of pirates, jagged reefs and deadly icebergs. These seas have swallowed up countless battles and tales.
l: This place makes up the waters north of the Northern Vale, with icebergs floating all year round. It was originally not suitable for trade, but due to the rise of the Abyss, the seas south of the mainland began facing threats and the Frozen Sea became the only route for many merchant ships. As trade flourished, pirate groups emerged at the same time. Because of ther existance, the Frozen Sea became less peaceful.

pl.t: Ancient glaciers have stood here since time immemorial.
l: "Dawn's Highest Point" Situated in the northwest of Northern Vale, this snow mountain stands on the isolated island, like a tower pointing directly towards the sky. It is extremely cold around the Queen of Scourge or known as Queen's Peak and the whole mountain is covered by snow and ice all year round. Standing on the top of the mountain, the splendid aurora can be seen. However, ordinary people can never set foot on the such place. Queen of the North, Aurora lives peacefully in this place until she was interfered by the arrival of Zhask.

pl.t: This was once the place where humans reclaimed their power. Now, it is the nexus of great mages and the magically gifted.
l: After Einwald had separated the two energies inside Gord's body, Gord was filled with despair as he could no longer use purest arcane magic, after his body changed. However, Einwald encouraged Gord to still continue his magic studies and offered him a position in the Ursula Magic Academy. Gord accepted in hopes of finding a talented student to continue his unfinished research. Valir was once an apprentice of Gord and studied here for some time. Eudora worked here as a professor of magic too. She is now the Dean of the Magic Academy, succeeding Theresa. Lylia was a top student in this Academy and so was Guinevere. The Magic Academy also seems to be in conflict with Eruditio about which faction is dominant.

pl.t: The massive stone megaliths have attracted countless pilgrims, but none dare approach it. Most settle for a distant glimpse at the remnants of the ancient races.
l: The Megalith Wasteland with its crimson ground is a place one must pass through when going to the Northern Vale, the landform is towering and barren. In the empty wasteland, there are huge megaliths towering into the clouds. These megaliths were built by Iceland Golems and used to serve as a powerful magic forcefield stopping the Golems from entering the south from the north. With the demise of the Iceland Golems, the magic forcefield was abandoned, becoming a relic that amazed future generations.

Agelta Drylands.q: Countless fragments of history lay buried beneath the sand dunes. Unlike Moniyan, the next chapter of this region still waits quietly to be written.
in: In the west of the Land of Dawn, there is a vast and boundless desert area called the Agelta Drylands. In the Moniyan language, Agelta means "yellow sand everywhere". The climate here is harsh and there are very few people, with strong winds all year round and other severe weather phenomena such as sandstorms occurring frequently. Only a few oases in the whole of Agelta have water sources, and serve as a stopping point for travelling tradesmen and adventurers. Although the climate is harsh and full of unknown dangers, it is rumored across the whole Land of Dawn that in the ancient desert labyrinths and ruins, there are treasures and the Twilight Orb left by the Ancient Ones. Therefore, adventurers from the mainland continue to explore the depths of the desert.
Except for the residences of a few aborigines, everything in Agelta is dangerous and unknown. Of course, in the eyes of adventurers, this implies unlimited possibilities.

pl.t: A miraculous source of water in the desert created by Belerick that has renewed the lives of the Eschackan people.
l: Situated in the middle part of Agelta, this place was just looks like other part of the desert. People who going on journey pass through this place frequently. However, after Agelta got struck by disaster several times, it became barrens and harsh by the day. People became more desperate and suffering as they lack of water sources and settlements.

One day, a tree nymph named Belerick got a revelation from the Ancient One to goes towards the desert. At the time when he was arrived, he saw nothing but despair on people’s faces. A kind-hearted Belerick detests this such thing and couldn’t bear any longer. A miracle happened subsequently, as Belerick unleashed all his power to create a beautiful Oasis.
"Save every living thing, save every life."
People were become pleased and grateful immeadiately. Travelers and caravans could shelter to this little heaven for once more as they on them adventure.

While creating the Oasis, Belerick unintentionally poured more power into the little flower, and the overflowing energy condensed into a glowing seed. However, the flower underwent an even more peculiar transition. It turned into a life-human form that had never appeared on the Land of Dawn. She called Floryn, and this place became her home ever since, isolated her from the outer worlds.

pl.t: A trade route that was destroyed in the great explosion of Agelta. The route has been buried by sand, its former greatness now but an echo in the desert wind.
l: "Desert Trade Route" The former Emerald Road is synonymous with prosperity. This main strategic point that enters and exits Agelta is full of cities and bazaars, and there are endless trade caravans that come and go. But after several catastrophes, all of the city-states including the Emerald Road was devastated. The once prosperous cities and developed trade exchanges no longer exist. Only the ruins of the broken cities tell of the glories of the past. Khaleed from Artha Clan used to adventured along the Emerald Road.

pl.t: A place where destiny is mapped from the stars, and where destinies end. Now, its last descendants are eager to take destiny into their own hands.
l: "Lost Astrological Sanctuary" Located hidden in the center of the desert, Stargate Valley has been the residence of astrologers for generations. In this place, the astrologers possess a unique abilities to foresee everything in the world. A young girl from Western Desert named Esmeralda was selected to be a new successor of the astrologers among other candidates through hard assessments. This myterious and ancient sand castles also has had a special mission: to monitor Khufra and keeping this evil tyrant sealed.

pl.t: Money and power, greed and desire, guns and smoke... all types of questionable characters have converged in this unsavory place, but it has become a place to discover hidden gems.
l: "Haven for Outlaws" Los Pecados, or so-called City of Sins located on the edge of Agelta. After the collapsed of the city-state alliance in Agelta, this once prosperous strategically important commercial town became a land without owners nor rulers. A group of scattered soldiers occupied it and started a disorderly black market trade here. Crime activitists such as smuggling, looting, fighting has become synonymous with this place. Thief King, Claude was born and trained his stealing skill in here.

pl.t: A city of scholars in the desert whose inhabitants are proudly known for their forward-thinking and free spirit.
l: "Oasis of Enlightenment" Known as the City of Scholars, sits in the northern of Agelta region. It was once part of the old Moniyan Empire before the empire collapsed. Eruditio broke away from the imperial jurisdiction and embrace freedom and tolerance. Some scholars and artificers moved here because of the empire's over-reliance on magic and their will to become the inventors. This is where Lolita works as the City Guard along with Bruno and Johnson. This place is also Layla's hometown. X.Borg once worked here before his hometown was destroyed. A competition called "Survival: Nexus" held in here too through its creator, Beatrix after departed Scholars' Union.(Also see: Eruditio (before 2023))

pl.t: The birthplace of the Centaurs. These mountains, like the life they foster, are calm, tranquil, and steadfast in their purpose.
l: This oasis in the north of Agelta is home to many races. This was the birthplace of the entire orc race, but with the changes of time, the Orcs and Minotaurs left here one after another. Only the Centaur live in the Misty Mountains in harmony with the nearby Eschackan tribe.

pl.t: An ancient labyrinth buried deep in the desert. Each night, the spirits of the Minoan ancestors can be heard whispering of the glories of their past.
l: "Ruins of an Ancient Labyrinth" Also called as Maze of Minos or The Labyrinth. The remains of the Minotaur Civilization at the end of the Era of Strife. After the destruction of the Minotaur civilization, the Minoan Labyrinth was cover with a veil of mystery. Some people say the Minos Labyrinth is the only way to enter the legendary Minotaur Castle. Others believes that Twilight Orb and Ancient Ones buried in here. There is a group of contractors who guard the entire maze. Aldous is one of them. He is the sole survivor of the divine punishment that utterly devastated the Agelta Drylands. As the sole survivor, he continues to guard the Maze of Minos against any invaders seeking the Twilight Orb. Chosen by the Orb itself, Aldous was saved and empowered as the Orb sealed within him the energies of two divine lords, enhancing his strength and ensuring his survival. This place is where Minotaur started his-self training with the Twilight Orb's power after being defeated by his opponent as he fought in local brawl. Esmeralda once came here to find secrets of the Starmoon Casket.

pl.t: The great ambitions of the Desert Tyrant lay buried here, but the wind and sand could not bury his anger and hatred.
l: "Remnants of a Fallen Kingdom" The Ruins of Tivacan are located at the westernmost point of Agelta. The city was once the most prosperous and powerful city-state in the western region. Its proximity to the ocean gave it a more favorable climate and rich products. But after its age of prosperity passed, this once-brilliant ancient city became the burial accompaniment of the tyrant Khufra. All the residents inside disappeared, and the ancient city became a forbidden place that made people take notice when they heard about it. And in the deepest part of the ancient city called Tihuacan, a powerful and brutal tyrant – Khufra was sealed.

pl.t: The wind blows over the yellow sand, carrying stories and recording tales. Given enough time, the wind will eventually carry one to their destination.
Live by fire, die by fire. Those who have been burned still call this place home.
A vast mystery, hidden beneath the sea south of the Agelta Drylands. Here, researchers work on state-of-the-art android technology.
l: Land of Dawn is a magical world with various natural conditions and many unique places. Among them, lies in the south of Agelta, hidden in thick mist, there is a remote island, called Baker Island. There, stands a huge laboratory founded by two professional scientists, Dr. Rooney and his comrade, Dr. Baker.

They had purpose to bringing peace for the future by invented new technology and experimentalize artificial creature to help the human race. Even beyond that, with the other scientists, the most important and arduous mission was human augmentation. Those who got severely injured body will be replaced with mechanical body parts. Lead by this such mission, the scientists wished they would have another chance to live their life, even they could become an advanced human with their new android body.

Not long after, the story about the Lab were heard by scientists from all around the Land of Dawn. They gathered and dedicated their energy and mind to create unique technology. Day after day, invention after invention has been experimented. Eventually, all their efforts are not in vain. They succeed combined a human and robot into one creature, a cyborg. More surprisingly, Dr. Baker was successful to have created a mechanical creature. It was just like human beings, made from steel skeleton and puppet strings and it has a pretty synthetic face. He called it an angel, then gave it a name –. (for more story about Angela, visit here)

Unfortunately, Dr. Rooney happiness didn't last long as there was rumor about a number of scientists like Professor Giraad and Dr. Octavius started their evil purpose: to create a killer warrior by combining human and weapon, making them as tools to kill whoever dares to stood against them. The rumor was eventually heard by Dr. Rooney. Thus, he decided to disbanded the organization and closed the Lab before it got worse and spread across the Land of Dawn. It was a hard decision since the Lab was important for human kind prosperous.

Of course, not all scientists agreed with Dr. Rooney’s decision, especially those evil scientists. They had intentions to stab Dr. Rooney in the back and take over the lab. These mad scientists started to abduct ordinary men, even children and forced them to become guinea pigs, even though they didn’t have any scratch on their body. However, some people intentionally came to this place just to seek more power without knowing the consequences. One of them was. He was obsessed to become an invincible swordsman, until one day he realized there was something not right with him. (for more story about Saber, visit here)

The laboratory that was previously established with the goal of the welfare of mankind was now became a hell for those who were reborn as mechanical humans. All those despicable scientists would keep experimenting and dedicating their lives to the laboratory for the reason of a better world. Will those madness cease? Or it will continue?

Moniyan.q: Home to the great plains and the most fertile region of the Land of Dawn. Known in the ancient times as the Land of the Gods. Now under the control of the human empire, where countless allegiances and betrayals have played their course.
in: Previously, known as Mossenia, is the region where most heroes of that region live. This place is the main setting of Dyrroth's invasion on the Moniyan Empire and the Empire Reborn Event. It is where the Lightborn Heroes live. The Lightborn Heroes protect and serve this Empire. The Moniyan Empire is ruled by Princess Silvanna and her family, its also the place where her brother, Prince Dyrroth was originally born until he was kidnapped by the forces of the Abyss.Benedetta was rejected when she signed up for the trials of the Empire Army because the powerful men who ran the Knight's Order were furious because of the "betrayal" of Alucard's father, the second division and the soldiers ordered that no descendant of a rebel could ever join the Imperial Army so that they would never seek the truth, just like Alucard did.

pl.t: The core and shining bastion of the human empire. A city whose history outlines the rise and fall of humankind.
l: "Capital of the Moniyan Empire" Capital of the Moniyan Empire. This is the most prosperous place in the Land of Dawn, and also the political and the trade center of the whole continent. Business people, poetsand travelers of all races gather here. The magnificent and wide Oracle Plaza can accommodate the tens of thousands of people who gather to witness and celebrate the triumphs of heroes.

pl.t: The place where the Church of Light was founded and its center of power. One foot in the light, the other in the shadow.
l: "Origin of the Church of Light" Built by the Moniyans who believed in the Lord of Light. At the beginning of the establishment of the Church of Light, the old believers and pastors used the Monastery of Light as the venue to perform various ancient and mysterious religious ceremonies. Later, the Holy Order moved from the monastery and came to Lumina City. Some people who upheld ancient doctrines returned to the Monastery of Light and followed the most stringent ancient doctrines.

pl.t: Dark magic runs everywhere in this city, just as it does through the veins of the members of House Paxley.
l: "Territory of Duke Paxley" Castle Aberleen ruled by House Paxley with its current leader, Duke Aamon. The other Paxleys are Gusion, Valentina, and Marcel. Carmilla lived in House Ansaac as the Princess of Castle Aberleen with her father, King Earl Ansaac until she killed herself and was revived by her lover.

pl.t: The discovery of gold brought prosperity to this land, but its depletion also led to its rapid decline. The fame of Castle Gorge and the glory of House Baroque are both things of the past.
l: "Territory of Duke Baroque" Home to Lancelot and his little sister, Guinevere, members of House Baroque. Castle Gorge is located in the southwest of the Moniyan Empire. It is the western capital of the empire and the largest city in Moniyan Empire after Lumina City. Castle Gorge got its name from the west being rich and full of gold mines. At present, Castle Gorge is ruled by House Baroque. As the oldest noble in the Empire, House Baroque has ruled the West from the beginning of the Golden Era.

pl.t: Among the port cities that held a near monopoly on the Moniyan Empire's maritime trade, two things shone the most: the vast wealth and lofty ambitions of House Vance.
l: "Territory of Duke Vance" Also known as the Magical city, this is where the Vance Family, Lesley and Harley live. Castle Grandrock is located in the northern port of the Empire, connecting the Moniyan Empire with the trade and economic exhanges of the Northern Vale in the north. The so-called Castle Grandrock is a city built on a big rock. The huge rock section and solid walls make it super defensive. It is currently under the jurisdiction of House Vance, which is named the Duchy of the North.

pl.t: The Swan Castle located near Azure Lake once symbolized the most beautiful love to grace the Moniyan Empire. To this day, people still wonder if this beautiful lake was made to be an eternal home or prison for the swan.
l: "Territory of Prince Alvin" Also known as Swan Lake. Located in the southern part of the Moniyan Empire, this is where the breathtaking Swan Castle stands near. Its beautiful scenery and pleasant climate make it an ideal place to live and cultivate. Once ruled by the Elves, the noble House Alvin now lives here in seclusion. They never participate in political activities within the Empire. As the collateral blood relatives of the Moniyan Empire royal family, they secretly guard the secrets of the royal bloodlines. Thamuz was secretly lurking behind to seek the truth about the Twilight Orb, where he met Lunox with Belerick and confronted Tigreal during the Determination Event.

pl.t: A common Moniyan saying to scare children is: "If you keep crying, I'll send you to the Black Forest!" But even adults are unsure of what really lies within this ominous forest.
l: "A Place off the Beaten Track" It is located in the east of Megalith Wasteland. A dense and primitive ancient forest, no one knows what lies inside it. Because it has been occupied by werewolves, no one dares to venture into this forest. Occasionally, the howling of one or two wolves resounds throughout the heavens. Roger lived outside the Black Forest, away from humans and in a cave. Ruby lived in a village near this area with her family until wolves attacked them.

Cadia Riverlands.q: An island continent that lies across the sea from the main continent of Dawn. A mystical land to the far east that has given rise to many heroic warriors and legendary tales.

pl.t: A Cadian city built under the mountains and surrounded by canals.
l: "City of Benevolent Waters" A Cadian city built under the mountains and surrounded by canals.

pl.t: Standing resolute through millennia, this grand city was built with nine sacred bastions arranged in a divine formation. Designed to mirror the heavens, it is now a beacon of prosperity.
l: "Mortal Capital" Standing resolute through millennia, this grand city was built with nine sacred bastions arranged in a divine formation. Designed to mirror the heavens, it is now a beacon of prosperity.

pl.t: A tranquil, idyllic village where the pandas live with other creatures in harmony.
l: "Home of the Pandas" A tranquil, idyllic village where the pandas live with other creatures in harmony. Stream Valley or so-called Kawa Village is located in the middle part of Cadia islands. This is where pandas like Akai live and enjoy a carefree life. This place inhabited mostly by pandas, though there are few humans coexisting with them.

pl.t: Flags and banners wave fiercely in the sea wind. The will to protect one's homeland will never fade.
l: "Cadian Port City" Flags and banners wave fiercely in the sea wind. The will to protect one's homeland will never fade. It is located to the northeast Cadia Riverlands, reconnecting the Frozen Sea and Sea of Hope. It is the only passage for all ships sailing from Northern Vale to Cadia Riverlands and further south, and also is home for Paenlong people. They had always been invaded by the pirates from Frozen Sea and Sea of Hope. Yi Sun-Shin is one of the Paenlong people, and with his Paenlong Fleet he would fight back all the pirates who dare to approach their lands.

pl.t: A domain hidden in the mountains that's said to have been created by the Great Dragon to protect the Cadia Riverlands.
l: "Domain of the Great Dragon" A domain hidden in the mountains that's said to have been created by the Great Dragon to protect the Cadia Riverlands. Located deep in the mountains and surrounded by thick fog all year round, this is the place where Great Dragon and his disciples live. The great power of the Great Dragon blocks the entrance between the Dragon's Altar and the outside world. Only those with permission can enter the place from the "Heavenly Gate".

pl.t: A sanctuary told in legends where humans, deities, and monsters alike come in search of inner peace, far from the turmoils of the outside world.
l: "Hidden Sanctuary" A sanctuary told in legends where humans, deities, and monsters alike come in search of inner peace, far from the turmoils of the outside world. Floral Falls is a serene valley where peach trees grew in every corner and petals fell gracefully like snowflakes whenever a breeze blew past. People who lived there practiced the ancient oriental martial arts and were called martial artists by others.

pl.t: A city of mechanical marvels that's rumored to be the origin of many ingenious inventions and the Hidden Weapons technique. Only a few outsiders have ever seen its true colors.
l: "City of the Hidden Blade" A city of mechanical marvels that's rumored to be the origin of many ingenious inventions and the Hidden Weapons technique. Only a few outsiders have ever seen its true colors.

pl.t: A city of burning braziers built into the mountains, filled with mystical wonders, and shared with the spirits of the deceased.
l: "The Enchanted City" A city of burning braziers built into the mountains, filled with mystical wonders, and shared with the spirits of the deceased.

pl.t: A land of falling cherry blossoms and timeless waterfalls, where generations of warriors from the Scarlet Sect and Shadow Sect compete to pass on their ancient techniques and traditions.
l: Many different fighting techniques and philosophies have been handed down from generation to generation by the various sects of the Cadia Riverlands, existing in perfect harmony, and the Ninja sect is the most famous of them all. The founder of this sect was the first disciple of the Great Dragon. After studying under the Great Dragon for many years, and attaining a divine level of self-understanding, he created the Ninja sect. The Ninjas possess excellent endurance and tenacity. Through constant and intense training, they learn to endure the most extreme pain and suffering, breaking through the limits of their physical bodies, and are able to fly over rooftops and walls to assassinate their enemies like invisible ghosts.

After the founder of this sect passed away, his disciples pushed forth the development of Ninjutsu and the way of the Ninja, establishing the Scarlet Shadow Ninja sanctuary in the north of the Cadia Riverlands. This village, hidden in the face of a remote mountain, is filled with Ninja temples and shrines dedicated to the great ninjas of past ages, where new generations can inherit the skills and traditions of their sect.

Over time, and through the passing down of diverging philosophies, the Scarlet Sect emerged, espousing different concepts of strength and skill. This resulted in the existence of two separate Ninja sects: the Scarlet Sect and the Shadow Sect. While the Scarlet Sect focuses on the use of various kinds of Ninja tools, the Shadow Sect focuses on harnessing the power of inner energy.

The Barren Lands.q: The main battlefield between the human empire and the forces of the Abyss. Through baptism by blood and fire, this region has become the harshest and most resilient land in all of Dawn.
in: The Barren Lands was where all abyssal creatures and evil spirits lived in.

pl.t: A massive mountain range stretching across the center of the Land of Dawn.
l: "World's Dividing Line" Lantis Mountains make up the longest mountain range on the Land of Dawn. It helps to block the corruption of the Abyss. It was said that the mountains were once the residence of the Ancient Ones. Benedetta and her comrades trained together and avenged those monsters at the foothill. This is the place where the Stone Titans including Grock remain. This is where Belerick had regressed to his form - Growth Wings. Paquito came here to eradicate evil and ended up defeating his former master, the Domineer in a duel. It is the place where Horror Castle is located.

pl.t: A desolate land of bones and totems that has become the last refuge for the displaced Orcs.
l: "Land of the Orcs" The place was the Orcs including Balmond live and find food for their boss, Alice, and the Blood demons, as they were enslaved by her.

pl.t: After a hundred years, the undead residents of Necrokeep no longer know if the Mist was there to protect them or to imprison them.
l: "The Undying City" The place that was once under Vexana's rule. It was once lively until the Lord of the Abyss and Alice's disturbance caused the fall of this place. Vexana awakened Leomord from the dead and he was given orders to protect the kingdom or else, watch the innocent undead face eternal damnation. Faramis is one of the knights, guarding this place. Lunox came here and remembered her past in the battle between Order and Chaos, as well as her destiny.

pl.t: A forest of stone where black crow feathers warn outsiders to stay away.
l: "Territory of the Crow Clan" The place where Pharsa and the crow people lived. It was once ruled by the Crow King, Osana until Alice invaded the people and crows and ruined Pharsa's wedding, causing, Pharsa's true power to awaken, which unfortunately led to her permanent loss of vision.

Azrya Woodlands.q: The birthplace of the Elves. A magical land blessed by the moonlight. During the Endless War, the forces of darkness corrupted the parts of the Azrya Woodlands into a twisted version of its former self.
in: This place is the home to all kinds of Elven creatures. This is where the Elf Kingdom is located. Azrya Woodlands is also known as Izirea.

pl.t: The eternal home of the Moon Elves where the first light of the moon falls. Deep within the Moonlit Forest, one can occasionally hear music and song telling of the Elves' history, suffering, and hope for the future.
l: "Birthplace of the Elves" The place that is home to all kinds of elves, such as Light Elves, Moon Elves, and Leonins. This is where Nana and Harith lived, after leaving their homes in the Enchanted Forest. This was known as the target area of the abyssal creatures.

pl.t: Teeming with glowing algae and giant plants, the Leonins live here amongst the trees, spending their days tail fishing. Each day in the Gleaming Marsh is filled with happiness and innocence.
A once beautiful forest that was permanently corrupted by the forces of darkness during the Endless War. To this day, the Dark Elves still long to return to their eternal home.
l: "Home of the Dark Elves" The place south of the empire, which is considered to be sacred by the Dark Elves. The once fertile and prosperous land now became swamp due to corroded by the Abyss. The Dark Elf Selena was once thrown in a bottomless pit where she got her powers from the Abyss Devil. Karina and Irithel and Gloo race also lives here.

Abyss.q: A giant fissure on the Land of Dawn that is as old as the world itself. The vast darkness here has given rise to countless bizarre creatures.
in: The Shadow Abyss or more commonly known The Abyss is the hideous scar carved into the Land of Dawn. Innumerable demons lurk within it, plotting to devour the light and plunge the world into darkness. Sealed away at the bottom of this legendary Abyss, lives the most terrible demon in the Land of Dawn - the Abyss Dominator. But as the seal slowly fades, the will of the Abyss gradually grows stronger.

pl.t: Located at the bottommost layer of the Abyss, a place beyond mortal sight. Here, the Sovereign of the Abyss was born, perished, and rose again.
l: "Place of Death and Birth" Located at the bottommost layer of the Abyss, a place beyond mortal sight. Here, the Sovereign of the Abyss was born, perished, and rose again.

pl.t: The ancestral homeland of the Fire Demons, where the lava and volcanoes that birthed them are found throughout. A cradle for demons, and a grave for all others.
l: "Land of Fire Demons" The home of the Fire Demons lead by Thamuz who was appointed Chief of the Abyss. The ancestral homeland of the Fire Demons, where the lava and volcanoes that birthed them are found throughout. A cradle for demons, and a grave for all others.

pl.t: A lair built upon inverted ancient remains, symbolizing the power and ambition of Alice, the Queen of Blood.
l: "Blood Demon Forces" A lair built upon inverted ancient remains, symbolizing the power and ambition of Alice, the Queen of Blood.

Vonetis Sea.q: These tropical waters are dotted with islands containing magnificent civilizations and undiscovered mysteries.
in: Vonetis Sea is the most beautiful archipelago in the Land of Dawn. Located in southern regions, the islands are called home for tribes that lives here. Those are an ideal place to live and a natural harbor with their beautiful scenery and pleasant climate.

pl.t: An important hideaway during the era of the Endless War that still holds many ancient secrets.
l: "Hometown of the Yasson" A mysterious high-tech empire, where the strange race of Yasson like Karrie lives. With human looks but deformed feet, they are agile and born to fight.

pl.t: After the Celestial Palace fell, this island became the last remnant of the Ancient Ones' civilization.
From afar, it gives off the appearance of blue flames dancing above the sea.
l: "Tropical Island" Blue Flame is located in northern part of Vonetis islands. The entire island shrouded in blue mist all year round, which gives it its name. According to legend, in the deep ocean near Blue Flame Island, there live intelligent fish people.

pl.t: An island that's called the Pearl of the Southern Seas.
l: "Tropical Island" Perlas is located in the center of Vonetis Islands. There are many ports here for the islanders to enter and exit the islands and conduct trade. It is also the largest gathering place for the Dorik people. Lapu-Lapu lives peacefully with other Doricans in this island.

pl.t: An island known for its long summer days and legendary monsters within its waters.
l: "Tropical Island" There was a village and a huge fishing ground in the southernmost island of Vonetis Islands. Badang, a brave man from this village tirelessly helped people ease their difficulties. However as the Abyss spread, the sea water near Solari began to be corroded by the Abyss.

pl.t: A tear in the fabric of time and space that connects different worlds. On rare occasions, beings from other worlds have arrived at the Land of Dawn through these rifts.
A paradise with friendly people and a warm, pleasant climate, that's ruled by a wise hero-king.
l: "City of Warmth and Hospitality" Also known as Mahar Pura, the City of the Sand is a prosperous kingdom with the great historical position. Ruled by Minsitthar, who is regarded as one of the four greatest Generals of Mahar Pura.

f: Moonlight Archer; Priestess of the Moon
Lunar Temple; Moniyan Empire; The Abyss (enemies)
Summons Moonlight Shadows and Moon Eclipse; Invisibility
Estes (older brother); Alucard (love interest); Alice, Balmond (enemies)

b.q: The Moon Priestess guarding the Azrya Woodlands

b.p: Born at the end of the Era of Strife, Miya bore witness to the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss defiled the Shadow Swamp and corrupted many of her people into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis over Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to thrive again under its protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded by the fog of war. From the Moonlit Forest, a call to war that has not been heard in thousands of years sounded again. Miya took up her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people. "What is war, brother?""When the races of the Land of Dawn turned on one another instead of embracing unity and mutual prosperity, that is war. When they invaded their neighbors and razed cities to the ground, that is war. When they chose destruction over peace, cruelty over benevolence, and corruption over purity... that is war.""Peace, benevolence, and purity... is that your wish for the world?"Estes did not reply. The outstretched branches of the Tree of Life wrapped around him, and he fell back into deep slumber.This time he would not awaken again for many years. Long enough for Miya to grow from a little girl, who couldn't even reach the branches of the Tree of Life, into a fearless warrior and protector of the Moonlit Forest.

Miya stood atop the trees and scouted the enemy incursion. A warband of orcs and demons had just broken through the border, inflicting a wound on the Lunar Aegis that caused the Tree of Life to shake. With a draw of her bow, three silvery beams of moonlight gracefully danced through the branches before swiftly slaying the leader and sending the rest fleeing in disarray. With the threat gone, the elves channeled the energy from the Tree of Life to repair the breach and restore the Aegis. Peace returned to the forest and all was well.Miya, nestled wearily in the trees, had assumed the responsibility of protecting the Moonlit Forest after her brother Estes went into slumber to preserve the energy of the Lunar Aegis. In the beginning, Estes would speak to Miya through the Tree of Life, and it was through these conversations that she learned of the peace, benevolence, and purity that her brother longed for. And in Estes's absence, Miya watched over the forest according to the last words he spoke.As she relaxed and put down her bow, Miya noticed that she had bruised her hand while dealing with the intruders. She began to recall the times when she practiced archery while her brother studied nearby. As a somewhat stubborn child, Miya would often shoot her bow incessantly trying to hit a leaf or branch, until her fingers bled. Her brother would look up from his scroll and, with a wave of his hand, heal her wounds with the forests' magic.Perhaps Miya was too attached to the past. She often found herself longing for a time when she could still hide under her brother's protection. Miya snapped back to attention and clenched her fist. This was no time to dwell on the past. She knew the only direction for her was forward, for she had become the hope that her people looked to in these dire times.But Miya knew deep down she was only lying to herself. She turned a blind eye to the outside world as evil gained strength, and only acted when the enemy encroached on her lands. While this has kept the elves from war, how long would it last? Even a fool could see she was delaying the inevitable. A war that's never fought can never be won.But peace, benevolence, and purity were her brother's wishes. How could she willingly plunge her people into the horrors of war? She could not; she would not.

But war comes and goes as it wishes, and it would come suddenly for the Moon Elves one bloodstained dawn. The orc shock troops tore through the Aegis. But unlike previous attacks, the orcs seemed far more savage this time, as if they've been sent into a mindless bloodlust by dark magic. Black smoke permeated through the forest as the elves awoke to screams and the crackling of burning trees. Great pillars of smoke could be seen from the direction of the Tree of Life.War was here."Run! Get out of the forest! Our home is lost, save yourselves!"Miya heard the desperate cries, and before she could act, most of her people were already fleeing in panic.

"Brother... give me an answer!"Miya made one last plea to the Tree of Life as smoke enveloped her, hoping for salvation, but the tree remained silent amidst the scorched earth.Miya looked around at her home, the place where the first oracle emerged from the Tree of Life; the place where the elves first took root; the place where their branches grew into a great empire; the place where the last pure Moon Elves stood firm against the Abyss's corruption. This was their most sacred ground, blessed by the Moon Goddess herself, and Estes's hope for their future.

"What is war..."She finally found her answer."When we have been pushed to the brink of destruction and finally take up arms for our very survival, that is war. When we must defend our last home, the Moonlit Forest, at any cost, that is war."The Moon Elves heard Miya's words and looked back to their home."My people! We have suffered for too long... lived in fear for too long. There is nowhere left for us to run. If the Moonlit Forest falls, then we will truly have lost everything. Who will stand with me one last time?"At first, a few dozen elven warriors stepped out from the trees. Then hundreds more followed, holding swords, spears, and bows. As they rushed to Miya's side, their silver hair shimmered like cascading moonlight upon the battlefield.The Tree of Life, too, answered Miya's call. Using its precious energy, the tree spread its roots in all directions to smother the raging fires, and reinvigorated the Moon Elves for a final counterattack.The Moon Elves rushed out from the trees and caught the Abyss legion completely off guard. They quickly gained the upper hand and pressed their attack until every invader was driven out of the Moonlit Forest. The surviving orcs came to their senses as their bloodlust subsided, and gained a newfound respect for the elves.

"I understand now, brother.""Peace, benevolence, and purity are what you wished for, but if we lose our home, our way of life, then all our efforts will be for naught. If war is already upon our doorstep, then we will meet it head on. We are prepared to sacrifice everything for our home. Give me the strength, courage, and faith to protect our people, and our homeland!"

f: Wasteland Howler (a massive axe wielded by his right hand)
Bloodthirst; Primal Vitality: The innate gift of the Orcs
Unnamed father; Alice (manipulation); Thamuz (rival); Alucard, Harith, Estes, Miya (enemies); Dyrroth (conqueror/defeater)

b.p: One day, the Orcs will break free from their shackles.

Across the boundless plain, the Orcs had fought tooth and nail in the name of "hope," an idea that spread like wildfire across the bloodied earth. This tainted hope was their poison—a sweet toxin lulling them towards death, yet the Orcs embraced it, convinced it was their fate. Balmond had not forgotten the truth. Even while serving beneath the Abyss's command, an untamed ferocity surged through his veins. Beneath the mask, ambition roiled inside. For Balmond, only two things mattered: freedom and revenge. And no one could stand in his way. So, he waits, patiently anticipating his moment to strike—to cut down his enemies in one fell swoop, then drink their blood.
The Shattering

Amidst the chaos of the Stormeye Wasteland, Balmond was born. In those days, the Orcs held but one belief: 'Only the strongest tribe can reclaim the honor of the Orcs, and carry out their revenge.' For this hollow promise, the Orcs surged forward one after the other, spilling rivers of blood. Balmond had believed, too. His combination of raw talent and brutality drove him through the ranks, as he brought dangerous beasts, rival tribes, and all opposition to heel. With the support of his people, Balmond became the favored successor to the throne. Yet there were also those desired no such outcome. A carefully planted rumor was spread among the Orcs: 'Only he who returns with the head of the Basalt Wyrm can rule as Chieftain.' Every creature in the Stormeye Wasteland knew the Basalt Wyrm's might. It was the fiercest beast of the land, and those who dare challenge it are destined for the grave. Yet Balmond, still young and bold, remained undaunted and set out, his spirits high with 'hope.'

Alas, this battle was not his alone. Along the way, Balmond encountered another warrior of equal renown. The two had crossed paths before, but now both vied for the throne. When their gazes collided, the air crackled. Then, suddenly, a distant roar caused them both to shudder. They glanced back at one another, this time in understanding: Slay the Basalt Wyrm, then settle the score. This brief truce, however, would bring them no advantage. It was a trap laid by Alice to eliminate 'undesirable elements' in the Stormeye Wasteland—a plot designed to destroy them. The Basalt Wyrm had been amplified with magic, and its overwhelming power thwarted their pride. Balmond's weapon was left shattered, and the other warrior had been gravely wounded. Then, just as Balmond prepared to face the enemy empty-handed, his companion extended his bloodied weapon.

The Orc warrior looked at Balmond, his eyes glowing with resolve. He refused to die a meaningless death, defying all attempts by others to control him: he was determined to pass on the Orcs' true conviction. 'Sever my head and draw strength from my blood.' It was just as stated in the ancient legends—Grow stronger through the blood of kin. The orc warrior looked at Balmond, gesturing for him to draw the blade. When Balmond met his gaze this time, all tension had vanished. Between them now was mutual respect and sincerity. In the name of survival, Balmond swung his blade and severed the warrior's head. As blood poured, primal vitality surged through Balmond, while Orcish tribal markings etched themselves onto his skin. The ancient bloodline cried out after long silence, and the power of the Orcs slowly awakened inside.

Balmond saw them—Orcs of old charging together across the wastelands, bounding beneath open skies. Blood connected them, and trust gave them strength. When their life-force connected, Orcs struck fear into enemy hearts—to fight one was to fight a hundred. Yet, their past had become nothing more than a legend. Consumed by greed and glory, and clinging in vain to Bloodright, the Orcs gradually fractured. Talent and strength now bred jealousy and conflict. Once like-minded brothers turned against each other and betrayed their own kind. Slowly, the Orcs became exiled, exploited, and as those ancient bloodlines fell silent, nearly extinct—until today.

But the battle was not yet won. The Basalt Wyrm lunged with its gaping maw, fierce and savage. Balmond stared it down, gripping his weapon tight. The weight of the world was on his shoulders. And the nature of Orcs could never allow him to submit! After fierce struggle, Balmond found the Basalt Wyrm's weakness. With swift precision, he struck down the crazed beast. The creature that terrified the land was now just another beast in the eyes of the awakened Balmond. He stripped the Basalt Wyrm's bones and forged them into a massive axe—its blade slicing through air with a sound like a beast's roar, causing his foes to tremble.

With his newfound strength, Balmond purged the tainted hope, setting it ablaze. However, the shadow looming over the Orcs was not yet lifted, as Balmond knew the Orcs' plight could not be resolved overnight. He could only offer feigned loyalty to Alice of the Abyss, joining her ranks to unite the orc tribes through different means. He worked tirelessly to prevent the Orcs from wasting away in mutual destruction, secretly rallying allies, rekindling ties, and biding their strength. He firmly believed the Orcs would return to the Stormeye Wasteland, breathe in the air of freedom, and revel in unified combat once more. They were born there, thrived there, and no scheme could outmaneuver the will of the Orcs. Enemies once called the Orcs 'beasts,' out of fear and loathing. But were they wrong? Only beasts can see through the masks people don, and crush their conspirators to dust. After all, for 'beasts,' survival itself is their truest conviction.

f: Duan Meng or DuanmengUnnamed village, Cadia Riverlands
Space and time swords, The blades of the Cosmic Rift
Longma (master); Zhixu (rival); Alpha, Octavius (enemies); Angela (ally); Zilong (former sectmate)

b.q: A swordsman in pursuit of invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718

b.p: Once called Duan Meng and obsessed with kendo, Saber came to Laboratory 1718 to transform himself in order to pursue perfection, but his memory was erased and he was turned into a killing machine. The torture of his memories drove him to finally destroy the laboratory and set off searching for the past. Deep in the northern mountains of the Cadia Riverlands lies a quiet and peaceful village. This village is home to the legendary Tianyin Swordmaster Sect, and is also the place where Duan Meng spent his childhood perfecting his technique.

As soon as he was old enough to pick up a bamboo sword, Duan Meng was determined to become a great swordmaster. While everyone else was still sleeping, he would already be practicing hard, and would continue until the sun set and the moon was clear and bright.

He knew that the requirements for entering the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect were high, and so, after countless days and nights of training in the wind, rain, and snow, the gates of the sacred temple finally opened to Duan Meng. Soon, his extraordinary talent and obsession with swordsmanship attracted the attention of the leader, Master Longma, who was once a disciple of the Great Dragon and the spiritual leader of the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect. Under the guidance of Master Longma, Duan Meng soon excelled among his peers and became the leader of the new generation of students.

Over time, Duan Meng grew tired of the stoic life of personal cultivation in the mountains. His obsession with swordsmanship and his innate ambition made him eager to challenge stronger enemies so that he could create his own legend and spread it throughout the world like the legendary swordsmen that inspired his personal journey. However, Master Longma denied his request to descend the mountain.

"It is not time yet. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." The young and vivacious Duan Meng refused to go along with his master's point of view. He was confident enough in his own ability and hoped to improve his swordsmanship through constant combat alone.

In the following years, Duan Meng traveled all over the Cadia Riverlands, defeating one swordsman after another, including the adherents of the Dragon Altar. He kept climbing toward the title of "The Best Swordsman" without a single defeat.

This was until Duan Meng ran into a man who would become his ultimate rival, Zhixu. This man came from nowhere and had no teacher. His life was like that of a sword, perfectly formed and complete within itself.

In their battle, Duan Meng was defeated, utterly unable to even fight back. In order to one day defeat Zhixu, Duan Meng isolated himself in the mountains and threw himself into a painstaking training regimen for three long years.

At the end of these three years, Duan Meng felt ready to fight Zhixu again, and emerged from the mountains. But as fate would have it, his opponent had made even greater progress in these three years. He was defeated again, and his sword was even slashed in half by his opponent.

Duan Meng's repeated failure reminded him of his master's words: "It is not time yet. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." However, Duan Meng knew that he had already done everything he could, and there was no way for the sword in his hand to become any faster or stronger.

In order to seek out a truly invincible swordsmanship style, Duan Meng left the confines of the Cadia Riverlands and journeyed throughout the Land of Dawn. During his travels, he overheard rumors regarding Laboratory 1718 - that they could stimulate the potential of the human body through artificial transformation, granting one more power. Duan Meng could not resist inquiring further. If this rumor were true, he might still stand a chance of reaching the very peak of swordsmanship. As long as he could become stronger, he was willing to do anything.

At this time, the evil scientists of Laboratory 1718 were also interested in this swordsman from the East. They were preparing a new augmentation project to create a human weapon. As soon as the two parties came to an agreement, an unprecedented transformation began.

After numerous experiments and operations, the project was finally successful, and a being with mechanical strength and human sword skills and sentience was born. But after waking up, Duan Meng had forgotten everything about himself, including his own name. He was then given a new code name by his creator: Saber. The sword of Laboratory 1718, Saber became a tool used for hunting down those who stood against them.

Of course, this was all part of Laboratory 1718's plan. They intended on luring just the right person to help complete their human weapon plan. Once the transformation had been completed, Duan Meng, who once dreamt of reaching the very height of swordsmanship, no longer existed. Instead, the ruthless mechanical killer, Saber, was born.

Though his creators were convinced they had achieved great success, as time went by, the familiar moves, the feeling of holding his sword in his hands, kill after kill, day after day—something began to stir within Saber.
