b.p: With the advancement of civilization and the growth of population, the damage humans brought to nature caused a grave change to the laws of the world — the emergence of the "Darkside". Also known as the "Dark Realm", it gathers the evil thoughts of humans, and from them, gives birth to the "Soul Eaters". These monsters can derive human power to reproduce and become stronger.

Soul Eaters cannot be perceived by average humans and are very hard to destroy. They have the power to corrupt thoughts and spread like a plague. Once they arrive in the human world, wars and chaos will happen everywhere, resulting in massive destruction. These monsters born from evil human thoughts have led human society to collapse at its peak.

The appearance of the Dark Realm has also stimulated the Eterna of Aeternitas. Under the influence of the Eterna, a special breed of humans emerged, those who can see the Soul Eaters and use the "Psionic" granted by Eterna to fight them. They call themselves Exorcists.

After years of fighting and cleansing, the Exorcists sealed the connection between the two worlds under the lead of the five clans and stopped the Dark Realm from corrupting the human world. But they were unable to totally sever the connection between worlds, meaning that there will always be some Soul Eaters breaching the seal and entering the human world, with rifts always appearing in large cities with massive populations.
The killing has never stopped.
Exorcists are humans enlightened by the Eterna, they can use exorcism skills of different types to fight the Soul Eaters.

Exorcists will undergo years of rigorous training, allowing them to master monsterology, magic, alchemy, history, and other knowledge, along with physical and skill training. The training of an Exorcist is the act of turning a human into a powerful killing machine, and their reaction and sensory abilities will be greatly enhanced. Ordinary humans are completely outgunned against Exorcists, the duty of an Exorcist is to hunt down Soul Eaters.
Exorcists use different kinds of weapons that most suits them. They also use various kinds of items (such as potions), psychic skills, and a type of magic called enchantment.

The Association of Exorcists is an organization formed by the Exorcists and their supporters centuries ago. Its original name is "Essence", which means "those who know the essence of the world". The founding tenet of this organization is to "cleanse the Soul Eaters and protect the world".

As time has gone by, the organization has grown bigger and bigger and developed into multiple societies. A society is usually led by an elder and may contain several divisions. These societies still hold their original aspiration and fight for the human race in the darkness.

Today, the Association of Exorcists holds one division in each of the five major sectors of the world (Glenarm in the west, Mannoroth in the east, Sunderland in the north, Exeter in the south, and Topsham in the center). Each division has a director, several Exorcists, and other department members.

All these divisions (located in Gold City, Fire City, Water City, Earth City and Wood City) are disguised as companies and built on the space rifts that connect the human world and the Dark Realm. Their duties are to monitor anomalies in the Dark Realm, enhance space seals, and cleanse Soul Eaters who make their way into the human world.
"I'm no one's instructor, and I need a partner like I need a hole in the head."
After being reunited with Kagura two years after the fact, these were the first words out of Yu Zhong's mouth.
"But my application was already approved! Shisho, please reconsider!"
A slyly apologetic smile crept across Kagura's face as she bowed. She spoke with an unshakeable resolve.

This was not the first time the two had met. In fact, Kagura owed her life to Yu Zhong. During a hellacious blizzard two years prior, Yu Zhong had rescued her from the clutches of Soul Eaters at a remote shrine near the outskirts of Wood and brought her back to the Association of Exorcists. Since then, the 14-year-old girl started her exorcist training while Yu Zhong continued his search for Soul Eaters as a lone wolf.

Yu Zhong never thought their paths would cross again, and yet here he was, two years later, listening to Kagura as she laid out the plans of the Association: Being a newly recruited exorcist, Kagura was to become Yu Zhong's pupil, and the two of them would form an Exorcist Squad. Yu Zhong operated alone, and vehemently opposed this arrangement. Despite the fact that Kagura had experienced much of the same personal tragedy (her family had also been massacred by Soul Eaters), Yu Zhong was unmoved. In the wake of his family's demise and being betrayed by those closest to him, Yu Zhong's life had long been deprived of any meaning or aspiration. In its place, there was only hatred, inexhaustible and unending.

A burnt and tattered copy of Yu Zhong's family tree hung at the headboard of his bed. Every name except for "Yu Zhong" and "Qi" had been scratched out in red. It was Yu Zhong's way of reminding himself never to forget. Revenge was the only thing keeping him alive. He had to do something, or else the darkness growing inside him would slowly devour him. For Yu Zhong, the inexperienced Kagura would only hold him back.

Time and time again he walked out of his house, he would see Kagura waiting patiently outside the door, but he paid her no mind. He refused to acknowledge this new "student" of his who had seemingly fallen from the sky.
One day, an ear-piercing alarm rang throughout the building. The psionic detection team was picking up abnormal activity, and Yu Zhong and Kagura were send to the 7th Ward to investigate.

Arriving at the scene, they saw that the Purification Curtain (the protective barrier between the two worlds) had been opened, creating a sort of light mask. Although it was difficult to make out, everything was serene outside the mask. Inside, however, an insidious-looking mist whirled.

Yu Zhong remained indifferent. This wasn't his first rodeo, after all, and he had become accustomed to sights such as this. Being that it was Kagura's first mission, she wore a contrasting expression of grave earnestness. The moment she stepped past the curtain, she would be putting herself in harm's way and would have to face the Soul Eaters.
"Looks like this is just a code yellow. Nothing a novice shouldn't be able to handle on their own. Let's consider this a trial run and see how you do."
"If you pull if off, I might consider taking you on as my student. If you can't hack it, you might end up as their food. If you're not up to it, now's the time to let me know."
This was the most Yu Zhong had spoken to Kagura since they had been lumped together. He spoke in a dispassionate monotone as if he was going over some humdrum detail.
Without hesitation, Kagura took out her badge and strode forward without saying a word, leaving Yu Zhong behind her.
The exorcist emblem began to shake violently; a warning that the demonic threat level was increasing. Yu Zhong glanced into the deeper recesses of the boundary...

Kagura quickly located the Soul Eater that was possessing a human body. In an attempt to obtain a fresh soul, it was trying to tear the spiritual membrane which covered the dormant humans. Kagura unfurled her umbrella, Reicho Kasa, and took aim at the charging demon.

The fight did not last long. Using the power of the umbrella, Kagura eradicated the Soul Eater. Her mission complete, Kagura felt a great sense of pride wash over her. Finally, she would win Yu Zhong's approval. Just then, in this moment of complacency, her exorcist emblem began to quiver.

Before Kagura had any time to react, a contorted figure appeared behind her and dealt a heavy blow. It was a Soul Eater that could conceal its presence, and was far more powerful than the other creatures Kagura has just dispatched. During the previous fight, it had remained hidden and had been watching from a distance, waiting for the moment when Kagura let her guard down so that it could strike.

Kagura gritted her teeth as she struggled to her feet. The previous fight had exhausted all of her energy; she was in no state to face the creature that stood before her. Despite this, she nevertheless adopted a fighting stance, refusing to bow down to this foul creature. She knew that if she backed down, the creature would go on to harm more innocent people.

The fight was practically over before it even began. Kagura used every last ounce of strength she had left in her, but it was not enough to subdue the creature, and she found herself slowly being overcome by it. Just as she was about to lose consciousness, she saw a hulking figure appear in front of her, just like the one that she'd seen in that blizzard two years before...

When she came to, the black mist had been dispelled. She had been propped against a street bench. Around her, people came and went as if nothing had happened. Besides her, Yu Zhong sat watching the crowds.
As Kagura straightened up, her head slumped down. She said nothing. She had failed. "I'm sure I don't have to tell you that you didn't pass."
He stood up, facing Kagura, "You better start training hard. I don't want my student holding me back."
"Wait, what...?" Kagura couldn't believe her ears.
"Come on, let's have some barbecue. I'm buying."
Without any further explanation, Yu Zhong turned and headed towards the throng of pedestrians.
Staring at Yu Zhong's back, Kagura remained frozen in place. After a moment, she snapped out of it, and scurried after Yu Zhong, hollering, "I want lots of cumin!"
After catching up to Yu Zhong, she excitedly rattled off the various names she thought would be best for their squad.
In the glow of the setting sun, their long shadows were stretched upon the sidewalk.
Yu Zhong maintained his flinty stare as Kagura's eyes brimmed with glee.
Kagura had that dream again. Once more, she ran alone into the mountain forests. Gloomy trees block her sight and make her heart beat fast, but she doesn't come to a halt.
"Kagura..." A familiar voice comes from ahead. Kagura looks towards the sound and sees her big sister Tokoyo standing under a tree, robed in a ray of moonlight.
"Sis!" Kagura shouts in her heart and runs towards her sister, but to her surprise, she misses her step and falls into a bottomless hole...

"No!" Kagura wakes from the nightmare and sits up on the bed. She breathes heavily for a while and then looks at the photo frame on the table beside the bed. In the yellowed photograph, she and her sister are holding hands, smiling. That year, Kagura was 6, while Tokoyo was 14.
Interrupted by a nightmare, Kagura was now wide awake. She pulled down her long hair and sat with her back against the wall, holding her curled legs in her arms.

15 years ago, Kagura was born into the Mitama Clan. In the bloodline test after birth, she echoed with the family's relic — the Exorcism Umbrella. This made her a focus of her clan as no one could wield this powerful umbrella for centuries. From that day on, the umbrella stayed with Kagura at all times and witnessed every trouble she made and all her joys and sorrows.
The clan placed great hopes on Kagura, but her family didn't push her too much. Instead, her family members gave her so much love, especially her sister Tokoyo.

Tokoyo was the young genius of the Mitama Clan. Before Kagura was born, the elders looked highly upon her and were expecting that it would be her who would command the Exorcism Umbrella. Tokoyo worked very hard to live up to the expectations and started practicing exorcism at the age of 5.

Tokoyo was revealed to be a talented exorcist very soon and became the youngest exorcist in the clan, but she wasn't satisfied with this. She tried many times to interact with the Exorcism Umbrella, but none of it worked. And then, Kagura was born...

Kagura's connection with the Exorcism Umbrella made her the top candidate for the next clan leader in the elders' eyes. It took away a lot of the attention that would have been focused on Tokoyo, but this was actually a relief for her. She never felt annoyed as she didn't want to bear the burden of the clan's expectations.

Tokoyo acted indifferent to others but was very soft and caring to her sister. To protect her younger sister, she worked even harder in training. Under the care of her sister and family, Kagura was getting stronger every day. Although she could interact with the Exorcism Umbrella, she still couldn't command it as she wanted.

On Kagura's 14th birthday, her clan members held a ceremony as was their custom, and that was the day when Qi led an army of Soul Eaters into the clan in an attempt to break the seal node here. The clan members fought resolutely with the invaders while Tokoyo protected Kagura who had no fighting experience.
The clan members, outnumbered and outmatched, couldn't repel the Soul Eaters and were killed one by one...

After killing everyone who stood in his way, Qi found out that the Exorcism Umbrella in Kagura's arms was just the core of the magic barrier. In Qi's eyes, Kagura and Tokoyo were just another two rats to kill. He had only one target — the umbrella. Kagura hid behind Tokoyo, grabbing her sister's sleeve in despair.
But Tokoyo only smiled at her little sister and said: "Don't be afraid, Kagura, you have your whole life ahead of you!"
After saying these last words, Tokoyo put her hands together and summoned an ancient enchantment.

Before Kagura realized what she was doing, Tokoyo launched the "Soul Sacrifice" spell. Her body exploded and turned into a golden light that shined in mid-air. When the light fell on Qi, it severely corroded the villain and drove him away.

Tokoyo's soul merged with the golden light, circling Kagura once and then disappearing into the Exorcism Umbrella. Kagura's face was bathed in tears, she felt her connection with the umbrella had grown stronger. She knew clearly Tokoyo was existing in the umbrella in another form and she would protect her as always.

Tracking the Soul Eaters, Yu Zhong, an Exorcist from The Association of Exorcists, showed up and saved Kagura from the remaining monsters. Kagura was taken back to the Association of Exorcists, and later, she became a trainee. Kagura renamed the Exorcism Umbrella "Reicho Kasa" and took it with her every day. She no longer ran away from her training as she used to do, because she knew that she needed to be stronger to avenge her clan and her beloved sister.
Kagura lay back in bed, waiting for the morning to come. She stayed awake... She didn't want to dream again.
It was always the same one.
Association of Exorcists, Wood Division
Medical Department
Although it's the busiest area of the Association of Exorcists, a quiet spot can still be found.
In a private ward on the third floor of the hospital, a young man sits on the bed and stares out the window in fascination.
Beautiful scenery is not what he wants. He is just curious about what's outside the window.
To his disappointment, he sees nothing but the white clouds and blue sky.
The sky is just like the young man's heart — it looks vast and clear, but feels empty and deserted. So is the young man himself. Two days ago, he lost all his loved ones.

As a genius of the Psychic Clan, Qi was among the top 3 psychics in the Association of Exorcists. When Qi was very young, his Psychic Eye awakened and he gained the ability to turn into a dragon. Yu Zhong has idolized Qi since he was a child. At age 7, Yu Zhong got his Psychic Eye and the Black Dragon's Power, making him the most talented member of the Psychic Clan. Qi treasured this talented subordinate very much and taught Yu Zhong all his battle skills personally.
Under Qi's guidance, Yu Zhong became stronger every day, passing the test of the Association of Exorcists and becoming an Exorcist at only 12.

Qi and Yu Zhong went on missions together and were the strongest master-and-apprentice duo in the Association of Exorcists. Yu Zhong was very happy to be Qi's apprentice, but as time went by, he found that his mentor was becoming more and more solitary. From his master's usually calm face, he sensed something unfamiliar — loneliness.
This year, Yu Zhong welcomed his 18th birthday, but at the clan's annual ceremony, all his happiness was gone.

When the ceremony started, massive Soul Eaters breached the magic barrier and slaughtered the clan. At Qi's order, Yu Zhong left the battlefield to meet and guide the approaching reinforcements from the Association of Exorcists.
When Yu Zhong led the Exorcists back to the ceremony site, it was a hellish scene.
Qi stood among the dead bodies of his clan members with the Soul Eaters, smiling madly at Yu Zhong and the Exorcists who were too late.

Yu Zhong still remembers clearly how scared and painful he felt that night. The scene of his clan folks and family members lying in a pool of blood all over the place is something he could never forget.

Yu Zhong rushed to Qi in desperation, he wanted to see if the man was still his beloved mentor or not, but all he got were relentless strikes that warned him he was completely outmatched. When he lay on the ground, Qi's voice came to his ears.
"I have no stomach for waiting any longer, Yu Zhong."
"One day, you will walk the same path as me."
"Live, Yu Zhong, and hate me. Come to me when you have more power than me!"

The Exorcists worked together to fight Qi and the Soul Eaters while Yu Zhong could only lie on the ground and watch. Luckily enough, they forced the enemies to run away from the clan's territory and found out that the sealed barrier protected by the clan was not really destroyed.

Later, Yu Zhong was brought back to the Association of Exorcists. He was severely wounded by Qi in that night's battle, and had still yet to recover. The Association of Exorcists suggested that Yu Zhong recuperate and arranged a private ward for him.

Yu Zhong sobbed silently on the bed. He didn't want to recall the miserable night all the time, but he fears more about forgetting the blood feud he is bound to bear. Forgetting is not acceptable for him, not even a bit.
"Wait for me, Qi. I will find you and destroy you for the clan, even if that means I will fall into hell as well."

After the tragedy, the once optimistic young man forgot how to laugh. Hatred pushed him to acquire more power and become stronger. He knows that one day, Qi will appear to him again and he needs to be powerful enough to avenge his loved ones.
And he is longing for that day to come.

In the darkness, a man dressed as a ninja sat silently in the flickering candlelight. The flames of the white candles were stirred by an insidious demonic aura, causing them to be extinguished one by one. The faint smoke condensed into a set of sinister snake eyes. A deep voice rushed towards the man from the darkness, "Our game is coming to an end..."

The man furrowed his brow slightly, his hand gradually reaching behind him. The candlelight died out. An enormous serpent-like demon appeared amidst the aura, and the man unsheathed the ancient demon-sealing sword on his back.
"How much longer can you keep me sealed away?"
"Give up, submit to me, and become my vessel!"
Hayabusa opened his eyes and returned to reality from his inner world.

He was sitting in the Hikage Clan's cemetery, with no memorial halls or tombstones, only countless graves and ninja weapons leaning against them. Each weapon served as a monument for a fallen Dark Ninja, accompanying them in their eternal rest.

At that moment, accompanying Hayabusa as he paid tribute to his clan members, was the ancient sealing sword - the Kusanagi, emanating a purple glow. Hayabusa gently caressed the Kusanagi reflecting quietly on his life.

In the world of exorcists, there exists a unique family - the Hikage Clan, a lineage of exorcist ninjas. These exceptional ninjas lurk in the shadows, employing immense determination and tireless effort to carry out the secret orders of the Association of Exorcists. They fight in silence, achieve victory in silence, and sacrifice in silence...

Within the Association of Exorcists, members of the Hikage Clan are commonly referred to as "Dark Ninjas". These Dark Ninjas are a special force directly commanded by the five elders of the Association. The legendary yet elusive Hayabusa is the current leader of the Dark Ninjas.
From a young age, Hayabusa could wield the Kusanagi, the sacred sealing artifact of the Hikage Clan. This sword also brought him a fateful "farewell companion"...

Several years ago, as the cold light of the Kusanagi flashed by, Hayabusa burst into a fray to rescue Granger, who was besieged by a strange demon. Granger, however, seemed ungrateful. Without offering thanks, he stumbled away, wearing a stern expression.

Hayabusa's subordinates scoffed, claiming that Granger was the infamous "Farewell Companion" who sent half-demon partners to their deaths, and it served him right to have no friends. However, as Hayabusa watched Granger's retreating figure, he thought to himself, "Ninjas, too, have no friends."

Meeting Granger was just a brief moment in Hayabusa's combat-filled life. Subsequently, he was ordered to launch a surprise attack on the demon organization known as the Shadow Council. After an earth-shattering battle with its leader, the Serpent King, both Hayabusa and the Serpent King were severely injured. Just as the Serpent King was about to release all its spiritual power and perish along with Hayabusa, the Kusanagi Sword emitted a purple light, merging the two into one. As Hayabusa awaited death, he wondered: "Why? Is the Kusanagi saving me? But if so, I..." The severely injured Hayabusa then fell into a coma. The next moment, he saw Granger's spectral hand breaking through the veil...

Soon after, Granger came to Hayabusa's side, announcing with a lazy smile that the elder had assigned them as partners. Hayabusa understood: he was now half- demon, a vessel for sealing the Serpent King. Thus, the Farewell Companion Granger joined Hayabusa, and they began their awkward collaboration. The Association of Exorcists' elders seemed determined to make use of Hayabusa before any issues arising from the Serpent King within him, so Hayabusa and Granger were forced to stick together through life-and-death missions. Hayabusa quickly discovered that the seemingly unrestrained Granger was a reliable sharpshooter, with his bullets always hitting the right target at the right time.

Sometimes, Hayabusa could feel Granger's gaze from behind, especially during the heat of battle. He even caught glimpses of worry and... reluctance in Granger's eyes. "Was he concerned about me? Indeed, I was worried too. Every time I drew the Kusanagi to release the Serpent King's power, the seal would become more unstable. I can't contain it much longer..."

After one battle, the duo received a new directive: find the strongest rogue exorcist - Qi. Hayabusa gazed at the rain-soaked streets and his distorted reflection in a puddle, and for the first time, he spoke: "I want to go home, to see something..." Seeing Granger's inquisitive gaze, Hayabusa added, "Alone."

Hayabusa, seated in his family graveyard, solemnly paid his respects before standing up and looking around. Ninja clans were hidden in rugged mountains, valleys, and dense forests. A gust of wind swept through, sending leaves and flower petals swirling through the air amidst the burial mounds. Hayabusa removed his mask, allowing his face to feel the wind and the beauty of nature. It was a beauty worth dying for as a human and sacrificing oneself as an exorcist.
Hayabusa looked towards the distant Wood City, the agreed-upon rendezvous point with Granger. Then, my Farewell Companion, Granger, I entrust everything to you.

On a rainy night, a man leans against a twisted willow tree, silently facing a row of tombstones before him. A flash of lightning reveals the names engraved on the tombstones: all exorcists, their epitaphs all written by Granger.

Ghostly hands emerge from the shadows of the tombstones, and the chilling wind carries countless angry curses: "You treacherous wretch!" "Why do you still live? Die with us!" "We were partners! How could you kill me?"

In an instant, countless vengeful hands overlap, and Granger opens his eyes, returning to the real world. The surroundings are calm; he's resting in an abandoned house, with his current partner beside him.
The rain seems to have stopped... For some reason, it always rains when Granger is on a secret mission. Granger's target this time is a renegade exorcist named Qi, and his traveling partner.

It's been three days since he received the mission, and apart from some minor demons, there has been little progress. Granger puts away his weapon, his mind preoccupied during the recent battle, and his gaze lingers on the sword his partner carries. This small, seemingly insignificant movement does not escape his partner's notice. They find themselves in a deserted seaside town on the outskirts of Wood City. The town's residents have long since moved to the bustling city center. Granger steps on the damp sand, seagulls circling low above the water, and memories of the past resurface.

Granger spent his childhood in a town like this. Many years later, memories of the people and events, as well as the chaos surrounding "monsters," have faded away with the decline of the town. Granger never knew his biological parents. He could see strange spirits that others couldn't, but no one believed him. His bizarre behavior led to him being regarded as a "monster." At the age of eight, Granger was adopted and brought into the Association of Exorcists, where he found others like him -the exorcists.

In the long battle against demons, some exorcists were inadvertently corrupted by demonic malice, eventually succumbing to possession. The Association could not accept the corruption of its members. Those exorcists at risk of demonization would be assigned special partners who would execute their comrades when the time came. Granger was one such partner, with a unique ability to absorb the spirits corrupted by demons, making him not only an executioner of the corrupted but also a vessel for absorbing their tainted power. This role, however, was destined to be unpopular. Granger earned the nickname "Farewell Companion", as those who ventured with him would ultimately perish in battle...

Granger had personally witnessed the deaths of numerous companions, their souls still residing within him. These vengeful spirits cursed him relentlessly, accusing him of betrayal day after day. Granger understood that he, too, was a potential risk: if anything went wrong, the malevolent spirits buried within him could escape and coalesce into an unimaginably powerful Soul Eater. Thus, Granger had no friends, believing that as a "living tomb" for the vengeful spirits of fallen exorcists, he didn't need any.

This time, Granger's partner to bid farewell is Hayabusa, a top exorcist in the Association of Exorcists and the leader of the Hikage Clan, known to members of the Association as Dark Ninjas. The bond between Granger and Hayabusa dates back five years.

Granger was ordered to head to a stronghold of the Shadow Council to assist the Hikage Clan in eliminating the threat posed by the council. Upon arriving at the scene, Granger witnessed the aftermath of a fierce battle: aside from the unconscious Hayabusa, all the other Hikage Clan members who participated in the operation had perished.

Granger brought Hayabusa and an eerie longsword emitting purple light back to headquarters. Shortly after, Granger received new instructions: Hayabusa had sealed the Serpent King within himself, and from now on, Granger would partner with Hayabusa, prepared to lay him to rest when necessary... From then on, the two began to work together, undertaking numerous life-and- death missions.

At first, Granger maintained a cynical attitude, keeping his distance from his partner who was fated to die by his hand. Hayabusa seemed cold and calculated, which Granger silently appreciated. However, as they fought together time and time again, Granger realized that Hayabusa wasn't emotionless he was a devoted ninja who, though quiet, was willing to trust his partner with his back. This trust made Granger waver; he could feel his own heart dangerously melting, but he was powerless to stop friendship from gradually blossoming within his broken heart. Granger began to rationalize to himself: maybe Hayabusa would never lose control? Perhaps he had found a way to suppress the Serpent King? But with each relentless battle, Granger eventually noticed a hint of change in Hayabusa a sign of impending demonization that made his heart sink.
At this moment, Granger and Hayabusa received new orders: find the strongest renegade exorcist-Qi.

On a rainy night by the seaside, Hayabusa, who was walking ahead, suddenly stopped. In a voice only the two of them could hear, he whispered, "I want to go home, to see something..." Granger looked at Hayabusa, whose face bore a sense of relief as he gazed at the distant horizon. "Alone." He added, as he walked towards the coast on his own... Granger's customary smile faded, replaced by worry and reluctance in his eyes. After a brief pause, Granger resumed his usual carefree demeanor, his mind made up. "I'll wait for you to come back, partner."

b.p: The V.E.N.O.M. are a group of people who have had difficult times are have been severely physically and mentally damaged by S.A.B.E.R. and the city. Recruited by Gusion, who was instructed to do so by Dr. Leo. The members of this squad are available as skins for diamonds each.

"Wiggins Sterling, president of Supernova Corporation in Zlatan, has been missing for half a year. His 15-year-old son, Dyrroth Sterling, will take over the company's presidency in his place." The news flashed across every screen on the streets of Zlatan. As the president of the largest energy group in the city, Wiggins made countless contributions to the development of Zlatan. To many of its citizens, including his only son, Dyrroth, Wiggins was the hero of the city. Meanwhile, in the conference room at the headquarters of the corporation, Dyrroth was attending his first meeting as president with the board of directors.

"We are deeply sorry that your father has left us. You are Mr. Wiggins' successor, but you are too young to bring us more profit." "We, as members of the board of directors, have decided to run the company on your behalf. Of course, you will still be the president of Supernova, but only nominally."
Dyrroth hadn't expected to hear such words from an executive, but he still decided to fight for what was rightfully his.

"First of all, my father is only missing, not dead. I've sent bounties everywhere to find his whereabouts." "My father has dedicated his life to Supernova; he poured his blood, sweat, and tears into it. I won't be leaving it in the hands of anyone else, and I most certainly won't let his efforts be for naught!"
However, Dyrroth's determination proved insufficient to sway the board's decision, as another executive then surprised him with the cruel truth.

"But do you really know the truth about our business? About your father?" "To tell you the truth, Supernova owes the power and influence it holds today to all the black markets under its control. They are the most important source of revenue for the company!"

With no one on his side, Dyrroth was forced to accept the board's decision. He couldn't believe that the man he had always looked up to controlled the black markets in the city. Dyrroth returned home and gazed over the rows of honors that decked the walls of his father's study. It was the first time he'd ever carefully observed the place, and one certificate in particular caught his attention: one commemorating Dyrroth, at eight years old, setting a school record in a sports competition. He could still vividly recall how he showed this first-ever prize of his to his father: instead of praising him, Wiggins scolded Dyrroth for being sidetracked from his schoolwork. Dyrroth had never again participated in such sports events. He took off the frame with the certificate inside, and an envelope slipped out from behind it. Upon that envelope, the words "To Dyrroth" were written.

"Dear Dyrroth. If you're reading this, something has probably happened to me. But there is one thing you must know, and that is the truth about our company's past. When I was just starting the business, I was invited to join the Zlatan Trade Association, where I got to know all the city's greatest business tycoons in the city, and they proved a huge help to our company's development. Yet I was also forced into becoming involved in underground black markets. By the time I wanted out, it was already far too late. I once tried to make you a profiteer, one able to take over the business, but it didn't work out. One day, you will have to deal with those experienced board members, who may well change you into someone else entirely. I can't say for sure. I had no choice, but you still do. If you are tired of the shackles that constrain you, then seek the V.E.N.0.M. Squad, and you will learn the truth about Zlatan! No matter what happens, I hope you can stay true to yourself, Dyrroth. With love, your father, Wiggins."
Three months later, Dyrroth stood before a burning building, armed to the teeth. This was the third black market base he had destroyed.

"I know your disappearance has something to do with the black markets, father. I promise I'll find you." "No matter how many may exist under Supernova's control, I swear I'll destroy them all. This is the price they must pay!"

Dyrroth took out his father's letter and threw it into the fire... He hadn't expected that his actions would draw the attention of V.E.N.0.M. Squad. They'd come to realize that, aside from their own number, there was a brash lone warrior fighting within Zlatan. But his reckless behavior had also caught the attention of the underground tycoons, who had sent people to hunt him down. While out on another solo operation, Dyrroth was attacked by cyborgs and shot multiple times before eventually passing out.
He found himself inside a hidden, repurposed warehouse upon waking up, his body cybernetically enhanced. Gusion was standing nearby, a cold look on his face and his arms folded.

"This is V.E.N.O.M.'s secret base, and you're safe here for now." "But if you insist on continuing with your rash behavior, well... We can't promise we'll save you again next time." "Go home. Go back to being a good little rich kid. Leave the black markets to us."
Dyrroth stepped out of the pod and looked over his modified body before returning his gaze to Gusion with an unswerving determination.

"My father told me about V.E.N.O.M., and I know of your accomplishments." "I won't leave the black markets alone, for I must find my father. Now that we have a common goal, why not let me join you?" "From now on, I'll be a rich kid no more. I'll be a V.E.N.O.M. Cobra!"

b.p: The S.A.B.E.R. are a cyber-themed squad based in Zlatan, an alternate universe's futuristic and sci-fi city. Their mission is to defend and bring justice against V.E.N.O.M., who allegedly stole the Ever Cube. The members of this squad are available as skins for diamonds each.
Freya had that dream again.

She was running alone in the deep woods at midnight, her vision hindered by the thick foliage all around her. While unsure just where she was headed and with her heart beating faster and faster, she still didn't stop.
"Freya..." She heard someone calling her, a familiar voice. As she turned to look, she saw her parents standing dappled in the moonlight, waving to her.
"Dad! Mom!" Freya yelled with excitement. She rushed towards them but found herself stepping into a hole, tumbling into an unfathomable abyss like a falling leaf.

No! Freya sat upright with a start, awakening from the nightmare. She caught her breath, then picked up the old photo frame by her bed. It showed her, at 12 years old, nestled against her parents. The corner read: "To Freya, my little angel. From Daddy, who will always love you". The girl in the photo was smiling with such joy that she could hardly believe it was her.

Freya's father was the chief editor at Zlatan's "Dawn Daily". Eight years ago, she and her parents were out for dinner to celebrate her fifteenth birthday. The family was chatting and laughing as they drove, nobody having any idea of the disaster that was yet to come. A heavy goods truck barreled toward them out of nowhere, slamming into their car...

When Freya woke up, she found herself lying in an ambulance. It turned out that her dad had wrenched the wheel to swerve away from the truck out of pure reflex, and Freya had hit the airbag. She was knocked out cold but didn't suffer any fatal injuries, yet her parents had sat in the front seats. Now, they had left her forever.
She learned from the police that the offending driver had fled from the scene, but by the time they'd found the car involved it had already burned to ashes, leaving them with no clues.

The lively, happy girl she once was had changed. Her parents gone and the murderer nowhere to be found, Freya was always quiet and gloomy. Her eyes, once sparkling and bright, grew ever colder. She even did all she could to forget her own birthday, a day that now would only bring her down.
The police investigated the accident but found no clues. The case was suspended. How could Freya give up like this? She made up her mind to find out the culprit.

She trained to join the police force in an effort to unearth the truth behind the accident. She was admitted to Zlatan Police Academy and became an outstanding officer, yet hardly spoke to a soul throughout the years; some thought her arrogant, while others assumed she was just shy. Only a few teachers who knew of her past understood how it was the crash that'd led to her being so guarded.

She graduated from the Academy with honors four years later, and was then assigned to the Zlatan Police Bureau's Criminal Investigation division. From then on, she set about investigating the accident that had taken her parents.

Freya found out that the case files had been classified as confidential, beyond the reaches of her authorization. She tried to apply for access, yet was told by her seniors that this case was no longer in the Police Bureau's hands.

Freya visited the newspaper where her father had worked, and learned he'd been investigating the city's black markets. He'd planned to pen a feature story that would expose them and cut the city's crime rate. Although he'd been threatened many times, he never even considered giving up; it was only after his death that the newspaper stopped the investigation.

It hit Freya that their accident must have been connected with that black market investigation somehow. From the newspaper corporation she acquired the files and data her father had amassed, and applied to the Bureau to take on the investigation. Mr. Wu, the leader of S.A.B.E.R., caught word of her application and was left impressed by the girl's persistence.
Not long after, Freya was summoned to the S.A.B.E.R. Headquarters. There she met Mr. Wu, the leader of Zlatan Technology.
"I heard about the accident you were involved in, Freya."
"That's what has led you to hate evil more than anyone else."
"You're precisely the kind of person our world needs. We appreciate your sense of justice."

Freya joined S.A.B.E.R. on Mr. Wu's invitation. According to their information, the car accident that had killed her parents was orchestrated by the V.E.N.O.M. Squad. They were considered the culprit for nigh on all crimes in Zlatan, controlling the black market.

Freya vowed to bring the V.E.N.O.M. Squad to justice. Under the name of "S.A.B.E.R. Manhunter", she searched for the V.E.N.O.M. Squad with S.A.B.E.R., hoping to find out the truth behind the 'accident'.

b.p: The evil powers lurking above the skies have finally interrupted the silence of the Dragon Altar. The Land of Dawn has been plunged into an Abyss of suffering and fear, under the threat of the Evil Dragons. In heeding the dragons' calls, the brave warriors step forward one after the other. The first hero, Valir, confronts his inner fear and fate as the Fiery Dragon calls to him.

Ages ago, under the protection of the Mighty dragons, our world used to be greatly prosperous and remained at peace. However, all this was before the vicious Kraken and his minions broke through the magical barrier that isolated the Land of Dawn from the external forces of evil. Charging in with his the minion army, Kraken prepared to launch an assault on the entire Land of Dawn. As expected, after these events, everything changed for the worse. To protect the human world, the Guardian Dragons met the Kraken with force and waged an arduous battle against the Kraken and it's the bloodthirsty army. However, little did the people know about the Kraken's secret power, which deprived the Guardian Dragons of their energy and abilities. Ultimately, the battle shifted to Kraken's favor and all the Guardian Dragons grew weak and debilitated. Running out of options, the Guardian Dragons had no choice but to retreat to the Dragon Sanctuary, a place initially constructed by humans, as a safehold for the Guardian Dragons. With what little power they had left, the Guardian Dragons summoned a magical wand, that was strong enough to withstand the Kraken's fearsome attacks. At the same time, they called upon all human warriors, brave enough, to protect the world from evil. Eventually, the first champion who successfully passed through the ward and the Dragon Trials heeded the call from the Great Fiery Dragon. Yet, countless obstacles and difficult challenges await him on the path ahead. Only by facing his deepest fears, can the champion embrace his true destiny.

b.h: Challenge of Wisdom: A Test of Estes' Destiny

b.p: To save the world from endless suffering, the Guardian Dragons harnessed their powers once more, sensing the Dragons' Resurgence, with themselves. The powerful Kraken hastened his plan to destroy the world, and dominate his dark reign. Inspired by the Fiery Dragon Warrior, many fine and noble warriors journeyed and entered the Dragon Trials. Among them, was a warrior from an ancient Elven Realm, who made his way to the Dragon Sanctuary, where the final trial of wisdom awaited.

In hopes of stopping the Guardian Dragons from fully regaining their strength, Kraken sent his minions to attack the Dragon Sanctuary. The shield protecting the century was growing weak. Attack after attack, the Guardian Dragons barely had the power to guide the Dragon Warriors. Falcon warrior from the Northern Vale entered the sanctuary and one would await bad.
While the Guardian Dragons tirelessly fought for the prosperity of the world, the Kraken was equally relentless in his attacks with a final warrior on her way to aid the Guardian Dragons.

The final war that would determine the future of humanity broke out. Freeze and sweep away all the forces of evil in the world with extreme cold. The warrior from Moniyan Empire is all set to engage the evil dragon.
A mysterious swordsman from the Cadia Riverlands heard the Dragon's Call. Hearing promises of divine weapons and rewards he devoted all of his energy and time to aid the dragons no matter the cost.
With another courageous warrior accepting the challenges of the Dragon Trials, the Kraken had another fearsome opponent to worry about.

Anyone would have thought the end was near but unexpectedly, the Guardian Dragons combine their strength. The Warriors who came to Ava ultimately, the Kraken met is ahead. The end...

b.p: center|144px Worldview

In search of a new mother planet and the Heart of Enlightenment, the Khastan people sent a team led by Alpha through the Abyss to infiltrate the Polar Star. A secret organization ""Abyssal Brotherhood"" was later established on this peaceful planet by the Khastans to better carry out the mission.
Facing the threat brought by the Khastans, the Society of Dawn on the Polar Star built an army of Super Heroes.

After more than 10 years of scheming and preparing, the Khastan alien robot troops were finally at the doorstep of the Polar Star. By action from within and without, Khastans had brought war to the Polar Star, the once peaceful planet...
"TREATMENT"? WHAT FOR? There was once a happy and peaceful middle class family in Lumina City on the Planet of Dawn.

Selena was born in this very family and raised with love and care from her parents and sister, Karina. But she had also been a sickly child and would always fall more ill every time she used her magic in secret.

Selena had a natural magic power of control and would use it to piece spare parts together into little gadgets. One night on the sisters' shared birthday, she even assembled a robot dog in front of Karina and gave it to her as birthday present.
Karina took the present, delighted yet worried at the same time, saying, "I love it. But people are now afraid of anybody with powers, so don't use it too often. Okay?"
"I promise. I won't use it again." Selena knew Karina's good intentions and accepted her suggestions without any complaint.

When Selena was 5 years old, she and her family went on a trip together but were unfortunately caught in the Bay Bridge Explosion caused by evil superhumans. At the heart of the crisis, Selena tried to use her magic to save her family, but the little magic she had was only enough to keep her sister and herself from falling to the ocean, while she watched as the cold water devoured her parents.

After the accident, Selena and her sister had nowhere to go but the slums. Everyone looked hostile when they first came here, before a football suddenly stopped by Selena's feet. A young football player, Bruno, hospitably invited the sisters to his shed, where they met Chou who escaped from an orphanage. Beautiful friendships then began between the four youngsters.

To help Bruno realize his dream, Selena encouraged the rest of them to form a team of three while she cheered for them from the side, since she was still sick from the impact of her parents' death and the vagrant life. They'd been called "The Strays" because they came from the slums, but as they won one match after another, more spectators started to support them, and even the cheerleader Selena had a cute nickname—"Puppy". This gave Selena an inspiration to make a profit: She would pick up one-armed robot monkeys and crippled robot dogs from piles of junk and make them juggle and sell lemonade outside the football court. While collecting spare parts to make more robot animals for her beverage business, Selena even handpicked the well-maintained parts and pieced together another robot dog for her sister, because the old one had sunk into the ocean with their parents in the accident.

Four years later, The Strays finally won the championship in the Lumina City Youth Football Tournament, before Bruno started his career as a professional player. Selena felt happy yet melancholic as she looked at Bruno whose dream had finally come true and realized her friend would be leaving home. But she still kept her hopes up, because Bruno promised before leaving that he would one day return and had also been sending them money to pay the bills. So, when Chou left the slums for the army three years later, Selena still believed Chou would eventually come back.

The old group of four was now left with only Selena and her sister. But to her, even though they had left to pursue their own goals, they would always be each other's family, and her sister, the most important person in the world to her, would always stand by her side.

In the year 2164, the Khastan people invaded the Polar Star on New Year's Day, and the slums near the Barren Lands were severely hit. In the crossfire, Selena used her power to protect her sister and herself despite her illness, but eventually collapsed from exhaustion. After waking up at hospital, Selena found herself alone with the destroyed robot dog, and her sister was nowhere to be seen. The search party asked her to wait, but the only news she got on their birthday the year after was her sister being presumed dead for being missing for too long.
Selena lay on the bed and felt utter despair. Now she had nothing left.
Didn't Bruno promise he'd take her sister and her to Lumina City after winning the matches?
Didn't Chou say he'd be able to protect her sister and her once he was enlisted?
Didn't her sister promise she'd always be with her?
They had all broken their promises.

Selena drifted in and out of consciousness when Alpha suddenly visited her. As the vanguard for the Abyss, he was searching for people with super powers to form the Abyssal Wings and found the talented Selena through databases.
"Who are you? What do you want?"
"Your sister is still alive, and I can help you find her. But you'll have to help me with one thing."
"My sister's alive!? Where is she!?"
"You must work for me first if you want to find your sister."
"I'll do anything as long as I can see her again."

Dead set on finding her sister, Selena agreed to Alpha's request without thinking twice, but didn't think Alpha had secretly planted nano robots in her neural center to amplify her dark thoughts during her treatment. So, Selena had a stronger super power after full recovery, but dark and evil emotions had taken root in her mind and consciousness. Her anticipation for Bruno and Chou, longing for Karina, anger at her own powerlessness, and the truth of the accident told by Alpha—all the pain had made Selena close off her pure and kind heart, leaving only the thought to get revenge on the Polar Star.

Selena was no longer the innocent and adorable girl she once was and had become cruel and ruthless instead, but deep down, she still had one soft spot—she had grown somewhat attached to Alpha and the Abyss because of her obsession with family and friends, and she even once again felt like home with them as time went by...

Upon Cybertron, the Autobots and Decepticons contend the over limited available energy resources: and so their long, arduous war wages on. In the midst of one of their battles, a Chronorift suddenly appears out of the blue. The two fanctions' leaders, Optimus Prime and Megatron, as well as the Autobot Bumblebee, are all sucked in to the Chronorift and wrenched away from the battlefield. The remaining Autobots and Decepticons watch as their leaders are pulled into vortex before it dissappears, and so they strive to open it up once more and lend them their aid.

On another side, Megatron arrives into this world and looks around the strange new planet, searching for the Decepticons' signal. Yet he finds nothing. However, he certain that his nemesis Optimus Prime is sure to be upon this world, too. Hence finding Optimus is his sole objective; finding him, and destroying him. As he searches around for him, Megatron sizes up this new and alien environment. Granger happens to be in the area, and comes across Megatron; having long been waging battle with demons, Granger harbors a deep hatred for all evil, and he senses immediately that Megatron does not mean well. Granger's rash attack upon him infuriates Megatron, and the two enter a fierce battle.

X.Borg spies on Granger and Megatron locked in a heated battle, and is thoroughly impressed by the latter's power. He believes that Megatron could be of use to him, somone who could aid him in destroying Eruditio that he hates so much. And so, X.Borg leaps out from the bushes to initiate an assault against Granger, a surprise attack that he cannot react to in time. Megatron also catches sight of the Cybertron landing pod up high in the sky, and elatedly seizes his chance to strike at Granger who's been knocked off guard. With Granger defeated, Megatron and X.Borg form an alliance.

b: The comic is set in the city of Los Pecados. Two young boys, Sewer and Bridge, visit the shop of Fredrinn. After a confrontation with a criminal in the shop, the boys witness Fredrinn drinking a red liquid, which they believe to be blood. When Fredrinn threatens them, Sewer steps in to protect Bridge. This action reminds Fredrinn of his friend Fray, who previously sacrificed himself to save Fredrinn. As a result, Fredrinn agrees to appraise their item in exchange for an apple.

Xavier's knighting ceremony by the Archbishop is depicted, where he vows to become a hero. The scene then shifts to the Church's raid on the Free Smiths' Guild. After witnessing a Raven kill a woman named Anne, Xavier questions the Church's actions. He unleashes a powerful blast at the Raven and orders a retreat, preventing the Ravens from finding Anne's hidden son, Julian. Ten years later, Xavier travels with his companions Yin and Melissa, having left the Church.

gold_low.title: You play well. The win rate is the problem, not your hands.
gold_low.text: Gold or MVP grades mean your own numbers in those games were strong, yet the games are still lost more often than won. That usually points to team-level causes: drafts that do not fit the hero, objectives given away, or games thrown after a lead. Your mechanics are not the first thing to fix.
todo: Play this hero with a regular duo or squad, so your good games are backed up.
Before each objective (Turtle, Lord), check where your team is and call the fight or skip it (Objective control guide).
Review two losses: was the lead lost at a single fight or objective? That moment is your fix.
Check the draft: if the enemy picked a listed counter of this hero, play safer and let your team lead fights.

gold_high.title: Playing well and winning. Refine, do not rebuild.
gold_high.text: High grades and a high win rate mean both your play and your results are strong. The gains now are small details: target choice, timing and the map.
todo: Read the Professional tips below and pick one to drill each session.
Take the Professional quiz and review the explanations of anything you miss.
Study a pro game with this hero in the Pro tab when one is listed.

silver_low.title: Both your play and your results can grow.
silver_low.text: Silver grades with a low win rate mean your own impact is average and the games are not going your way. Work on your own play first: it is the part you control in every game.
todo: Use the tips for your level below, one per session.
Practise the hero's main combo in Practice mode until it is automatic.
Cut deaths first: a game with fewer deaths gives your team more chances to win.

silver_high.title: You win more than your grades show.
silver_high.text: A good win rate with silver grades means your team often does the heavy lifting. That is fine in good games, but your results will drop when the team is weaker. Raise your own impact.
todo: Look for the moments the hero is strongest (see the tips) and take them yourself.
Track damage share and deaths in your match history, not just wins.
Take the quiz at your level to find the situations you are unsure about.

bronze_low.title: The play itself needs work first.
bronze_low.text: Bronze grades with a low win rate mean the hero is not working for you yet. The win rate will follow your own play, so start with the basics of the hero.
todo: Read the Easy tips below and the hero's guide, then play a few games in Practice or Classic.
Learn one combo and one escape before you take the hero to ranked again.
Consider a second hero for ranked while you practise this one.

bronze_high.title: Your team is carrying the results.
bronze_high.text: You are winning, but bronze grades mean your own part in those wins is small. Teams will not always carry, so the next step is your own contribution.
todo: Use the Easy and Average tips to raise your own impact.
Ask after each win: what did I do that helped? Do more of it.
Take the quiz at your level to find gaps.

focus: At this win rate, most Selena losses come from fighting in the wrong form. Elven Form is your setup: traps on enemy paths and long arrows. Abyssal Form is only for finishing a target that is already stunned. Play your next ten games with one rule: no ultimate until an arrow has landed. It will feel slow, but it stops the deaths that come from diving with nothing to follow up, and it teaches you the arrow range that makes the stun long.

You know the basics, so the next step is damage per engage. Abyssal Form's big hits only come from marks you stacked in Elven Form, and Garotte only resets when its damage triggers a mark. So the order matters: trap and arrow to mark, ultimate, Soul Eater, Garotte, Garotte. When you skip the marking step, your combo deals far less and your second Garotte never comes. Fix the order and your trades start ending in kills instead of half-HP enemies.

You win more than you lose, so the gains are now in map timing. Selena's traps last 60 seconds and up to three stand at once, which means you can pre-place vision and damage on the routes the enemy jungler must take to the 2:00 Turtle and the buffs. Combine that with roaming after you clear your wave, and your arrows start landing in fights that are already happening, where a stun turns straight into a kill.

At this level the question is no longer whether your arrow lands, it is what it removes from the fight. Choose the target whose engage or peel decides the fight, check that they have no blink left, and fire when a teammate can follow up. Use Abyssal Mark's bonus against non-hero units to take camps quickly and keep tempo. Review losses for arrows that hit with nobody near: those are the games your team could not convert.
tips: Learn the two forms first. Elven Form (Abyssal Trap, Abyssal Arrow) is for setting up; Abyssal Form (Soul Eater, Garotte) is for finishing. Switching resets the other form's skills, so every switch is a free extra combo.

Hit Abyssal Arrow from far away. Its stun grows from 0.5 to 2.5 seconds with distance, so an arrow fired point blank barely stuns. Practise long arrows on the training dummies until they land by feel.
Place traps on paths enemies must walk: bushes next to the Turtle, jungle entrances, the side of your lane. Up to 3 can stand at once for 60 seconds each, so keep them out at all times.
Do not dive with Abyssal Form unless the arrow stunned first. Without the stun, your Garotte has nothing to follow up on and you have no escape left.

The most common items in Selena's MPL Season 18 pro builds were Glowing Wand and Magic Shoes (118 games). Copy that core while you learn instead of experimenting, so your losses teach you about play, not about items.
Stack Abyssal Mark in Elven Form before you switch. Each Abyssal Form hit consumes a stack for big extra magic damage, so trap-plus-arrow first, then ultimate, then Soul Eater and Garotte.
Garotte's cooldown resets when its damage triggers a mark. Plan for two Garottes per engage: one in, one to chase or leave.
Fire the arrow through your own traps. The arrow absorbs traps on its path and applies their effect on hit, which turns a hit into stun plus slow plus extra mark.
Roam after you clear your wave, not before. Your win rate climbs when your arrows land in side lanes where the enemy is already fighting your ally.
Watch the 40% speed boost after a stun of 0.9 seconds or more. That burst is your window to close the gap and switch forms.
Trap the enemy jungler's buff and Turtle routes before 2:00. A trap that catches the jungler early wins the first objective fight.
Use Soul Eater's shield to survive the dive. It comes with the empowered basic attack, so attack first, then Garotte out.
Count your traps: each extra Abyssal Devil in the same spot adds 50% to the final hit. Stacking three in one choke point is a real kill threat in a team fight.
Hold the ultimate as an escape. Switching back to Elven Form resets the arrow and gives 30% speed for 0.8 seconds, often enough to break line of sight.
Against the heroes the official site lists as Selena's counters (Yve, Benedetta, Beatrix in Mythical Glory+), play for picks on other targets and do not trade into them.
Arrow priority in fights: the enemy hero who can stop your team's engage, not the closest target. A 2.5-second stun on the right hero decides the fight.
Abyssal Mark deals 285% extra damage to non-hero units. Use it to steal or secure jungle camps and to clear waves faster, then rotate before the enemy reacts.
Bait arrows: show yourself, step back into a lane with traps, and let the chaser walk into them before you fire. Traps attach and slow by 50% before they explode.
Track the enemy's flicker and blink skills. A long arrow is only safe to commit to when the target has no blink; otherwise hold Abyssal Form for the follow-up.
Review your losses for one thing: arrows fired with nobody ready to follow up. At this level the stun is only worth what your team does with it.

focus: Marcel is a Roamer, and almost everything he does needs an ally nearby: Platinum Snap shields you and an ally, and Golden Hour lets shielded allies keep moving while enemies are frozen. At this win rate, the most useful habit is simple: walk with your Gold Laner or Jungler instead of alone, and cast Framed Moment where enemies will still be 2.5 seconds later. Build defense first, because your damage scales with it.

Your next step is the snap-then-ultimate rhythm. Get the Platinum Snap shield on your carry first, then cast Golden Hour: frozen enemies cannot act, your shielded carry can, and the ultimate resets Platinum Snap for every enemy hero inside it. Use Tracking Shot's speed to walk in and its dash to cut off the escape route while Framed Moment stays where you cast it.

Marcel is banned in most Mythical Glory+ games (about 73% ban rate over 30 days on the official site), so when he gets through, your team is expected to play around him. That means reaching the 2:00 Turtle first with your laners, checking bushes so your carry does not have to, and saving Golden Hour for several enemies at once. Against the listed counters (Atlas, Sun, Kadita), let their engage go first.

Top-level Marcel is about what he removes from the fight. Golden Hour freezes projectiles already in the air, and targeted ones only deal 50% afterward, so a well-timed ultimate cancels the enemy's best skill shot or burst on your carry. Frozen enemies also stay inside your Framed Moment area for its delayed hit. Use your review time on wasted ultimates: one frozen enemy with nobody hitting is a lost fight.
tips: Marcel is a Roamer. Stay with your team, especially your Gold Laner and Jungler early. Platinum Snap shields you and a nearby ally, so being close to allies is your value.
Use Tracking Shot to walk toward fights. It gives 15% speed, and 75% when moving toward an enemy hero.
Framed Moment slows enemies in the area by 60% and hits after 2.5 seconds. Cast it where the enemy will still be, not where they are now.
Your ultimate freezes every unit in the area except you. Practise casting it on clumped enemies in Practice mode before ranked.
The most common items in Marcel's MPL Season 18 pro builds were Thunder Belt and Flask of the Oasis (102 games). Build defense; your damage scales with your Physical and Magic Defense.
Your basic attacks and Framed Moment scale with Physical and Magic Defense. Every defense item is also a damage item for you.
Platinum Snap has a 12-second cooldown per target. Rotate between enemies to snap more than one hero in a fight.
Use Tracking Shot's recast to dash. The Framed Moment area stays where you cast it, so you can cast it, then dash to block the escape route.
Golden Hour freezes projectiles too. Use it to stop a key enemy skill shot or ultimate mid-flight, not only to catch enemies.
Golden Hour resets Platinum Snap for every enemy hero inside it, so each frozen enemy is another snap and shield.
Allies with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely in the Golden Hour area. Snap first, then ultimate, so your carry keeps attacking while enemies are frozen.
Marcel's ban rate is about 73% in Mythical Glory+ over the last 30 days (official site). If he gets through the draft, the enemy team let a priority pick go; play around it.
Plan your roam path to arrive at the 2:00 Turtle with your laners, and check bushes for your carry. See Rotations by role.
The official site lists Atlas, Sun and Kadita as heroes that counter Marcel in Mythical Glory+. Against them, hold the ultimate until their big engage is spent.
Do not spend Golden Hour on a single target unless it is a kill on the enemy carry. Its best use is several heroes at once.
Freeze enemy projectiles that are already in the air. Targeted projectiles deal only 50% damage after the freeze, which can save your carry from a burst.
Combine Framed Moment and Golden Hour: frozen enemies cannot leave the Framed Moment area, so its delayed hit lands on everyone frozen inside.

Count enemy control effects before you go in. Marcel needs to reach the fight; pick the defense item that answers the enemy's damage type (Counter-building guide); Dominance Ice and Chastise Pauldron both appear in his pro builds.
Vision duty: you check bushes, not your carry. A Roamer who checks first saves the carry from being caught (Vision guide).
Review your fights for wasted ultimates: one hero frozen and nobody hitting. At pro level, the ultimate waits for your team's damage to be in range.

focus: Paquito is built around counting. Every third skill cast puts you in Champ Stance, and the enhanced skill ignores cooldowns. At this win rate, most losses come from casting skills without counting, then entering stance at the wrong moment. Practise in Practice mode until you always know which cast is your third. Throw Heavy Left Punch at heroes, not minions, because the shield only comes from a hero hit.

Now make each stance count. Enhanced Knockout Strike gives the airborne uppercut, enhanced Jab gives the biggest damage, and enhanced Heavy Left Punch gives the biggest shield, which stacks with the normal one. Decide before the trade which one you need, and set your first two casts so the third lands where you want. Use the 60% speed after the enhanced skill to chase or to leave.

As the EXP Laner, your first big test is the 2:00 Turtle, which spawns next to your lane. Arrive with your skills ready and your wave pushed, so you can join the fight or the jungle invade on that side. Aim the elbow strike's knockback toward your team or a wall. At this level you plan stance two casts ahead and use Jab's early stop on purpose: stopping on a frontliner saves the uppercut for the carry behind. Hold the haymaker's backward dart for the moment the enemy commits to chase, and review your long fights for stance count.
tips: Count your skills. Every third skill cast puts Paquito in Champ Stance, which gives an enhanced skill that ignores cooldowns. Learning the count is the whole hero.

focus: Nolan's whole kit is Rifts. Each skill leaves one that slows by 30%, and when two touch they pull enemies together and deal damage. At this win rate, the most common mistake is casting skills far apart, so the Rifts never meet. Practise clearing camps so your Rifts overlap: every activation that hits a creep heals you and gives 15 Energy, which keeps you farming without backing.

You have the clear, now learn the opener. Stay out of combat for 5 seconds so Cosmic Leap is ready, dash in with it to leave a Rift, then cast Expansion to activate the pull. Follow with Gauge and Fracture for more activations, and use Fracture's backward dash to leave. Rifts only last 5 seconds, so a slow combo loses its pulls.

Your win rate says your fights work, so the gains are in where you start them. Approach from fog or bushes so Cosmic Leap is ready, arrive at the 2:00 Turtle with Retribution ready, and invade on the side where your laners have pushed. When Estes, Baxia or Zhuxin is on the enemy team (official site counters), look for picks on targets away from them.

At the top, Nolan is a team-fight multiplier through layered Rifts: two skills into a clump means several pulls on several heroes, and every hero hit heals you and refills Energy. Use Gauge's path Rift as a wall across escape routes, and step out for 5 seconds mid-fight to reset Cosmic Leap. Review fights by counting activations per kill.
tips: Every Nolan skill leaves a Rift that slows by 30%. When two Rifts touch, they pull enemies to the center and deal damage. Cast skills so their Rifts overlap.

focus: Yin is a duelist. His passive raises his damage to 120% and gives 8% Spell Vamp only when no ally is within 4 units, and My Turn pulls one enemy into a domain where nobody else can affect either of you. At this win rate, most losses come from the wrong target. Before you cast My Turn, ask: can I kill this hero in 8 seconds? If not, wait.

Inside the domain you are Lieh with 50 to 80 extra defense, and a kill gives 20% Max HP, resets Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast, and keeps you as Lieh for 8 more seconds. So the plan is: open with Instant Blast for the damage reduction and the ring stun, land the Charged Punch for its cooldown cut, then pull. Cancel Frenzy Strike's second half if the target leaves its line.

You are winning, so use the domain as a team tool too. Pulling the enemy's key hero out of a fight for up to 8 seconds is valuable even without the kill. Fight from a different angle than your team so your passive stays on. Check the draft for the official site's listed counters (Minsitthar, Diggie, Floryn) before you lock Yin in.

At this level the domain is the decision that wins or loses the game. Cast it when the target is committed, not when they can step away during the delay, and avoid pulling a full-HP burst hero when you are low: the domain ends when either hero dies, and nobody can help you. There is no pro data for Yin in the app, so build from his kit and review every domain for whether the kill was possible.

focus: Kadita is a burst mage who wins fights in one engage. Ocean Ode gives Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while you ride it, and it passes through walls. Breath of the Ocean knocks enemies airborne for 1 second. At this win rate, learn one combo until it is automatic: Ocean Ode in, Breath of the Ocean under you during the wave, then Rough Waves.

Now use your passive and your exits. The Blessing of the Ocean returns 65% of HP lost in the 4 seconds after an enemy hero hits you, every 30 seconds, so fight when it is ready. Use Ocean Ode's recast to drop out of the wave early while it keeps moving, and use it through walls to escape where enemies cannot follow.

Your fights work, so the gains are in when you take them. As a Mid Laner, clear your wave before you roam. Save Ocean Ode for escape when the enemy has a hard-engage tank. Dive into the middle of the enemy team with Rough Waves so several waves hit on the way out and back, use Ocean Ode through a wall onto the backline and erupt Breath of the Ocean under you, and hold Rough Waves when a suppression hero is near. The app has only 2 pro games with Kadita, so treat that build as a sample.

focus: Khufra is a Roaming Tank: his job is to start fights and stop enemies. Tyrant's Revenge launches you and knocks enemies up when you reach max range or the first hero. Bouncing Ball raises your defense and knocks up enemies that blink across you. Tyrant's Rage pulls enemies in front of you and stuns them if they hit a wall. Learn those four facts and use each for its job.

Spell Curse is your sustain. Every 12 seconds your next basic attack gains range, deals damage based on the target's Max HP, slows and heals you 8% of your Max HP, and every control effect from your skills cuts 4 seconds off it. So weave basic attacks between skills: every knock-up is also a heal. Pull enemies toward walls for the stun.

Your win rate is good, and Khufra has one of the higher Mythical Glory+ win rates of the ten (about 54%, official site). Engage from the side so the ultimate pulls enemies into your team. Check bushes so your carry does not have to. Alucard, Silvanna and Guinevere are the listed counters; engage after their key skills are used.

At this level, use Bouncing Ball to block escapes through you, combine Tyrant's Revenge behind a target with the ultimate toward a wall, and hold the ultimate for the enemy's key dash hero. Review fights by asking one question: did the pull bring enemies into your team's damage?

focus: Hirara has no ultimate: two skills, Meisen-e (up to two dashes) and Kaerazu (a fan hit, then a delayed hit for twice the damage at the target spot), plus two combo casts you make by dragging one skill onto the other. Each combo spends one of her 2 Crimson Energy, and Energy refills on Meisen-e's timer. At this win rate, most losses come from spending everything on the way in and having nothing left when the enemy answers. Play your next games with one rule: never start a fight with fewer than two Energy, and keep the second Meisen-e dash for leaving.

Your step now is sequencing. Infernal Torrent (Meisen-e enhanced) spins after the first dash and immobilizes for 0.8 seconds, which is the only time Kaerazu's delayed hit is guaranteed, so the Kaerazu must already be on its way when the spin lands. Falling Maple (Kaerazu enhanced) makes you untargetable for up to 1 second and hits for three times Kaerazu's damage after 0.6 seconds; the second dash ends it early. Treat it as your dodge first and your damage second, and pick targets that are alone, because she deals only 30% plus 4% per level of her damage to minions and cannot win by pushing.

Hirara is banned in about 88% of Mythical Glory+ games (official site, past 30 days), so when she gets through, the enemy let a priority pick go and your team will expect the early game to go your way. Turn her early strength into objectives: kills before the first Turtle, then the Turtle itself. Check the draft for her listed counters (Yin, Hanzo, X.Borg, Alpha, Joy) and play the flank, not the front, when they are there. In fights, enter after the enemy's control has been used, on the carry or mage who is out of position.

At the top, Hirara is a resource game you play against the enemy's cooldowns. Count your state out loud before each fight (two Energy and the second dash, or less), bait the one targeted control skill that can stop you with a Kaerazu poke, then use Falling Maple as it is cast. Do not spend Energy on jungle camps after a fight: spending it interrupts the refill, so the next engage starts late. Review deaths for fights you entered with one Energy and no dash: at this level those are choices, not bad luck.
tips: Keep your budget in mind: two dashes from Meisen-e, one Kaerazu and two combo casts. Every combo spends one Crimson Energy and you only hold two. Before you walk at an enemy, check that both Energy are full; with one, you can finish a target but not survive a counter.

Use the first Meisen-e dash to close the gap and keep the second for leaving. The first dash always goes in your facing direction, so walk past or toward the target first and the dash carries you through them. A Hirara who uses both dashes to chase has no way out when the enemy roamer arrives.

Land Kaerazu's second hit, not just the first. The delayed hit at the target spot deals twice the first, so aim it where the enemy will be, or cast it right after Infernal Torrent while they cannot move. In the jungle, pull camps together and drop the delayed hit on the whole group.

Do not try to push lanes alone. Hirara deals only 30% plus 4% per hero level of her damage to minions, so waves and turrets go slowly. Your value is kills and objectives; leave waves to your laners and walk to the next fight.

The most common items in Hirara's MPL Season 18 pro builds were Hunter Strike and War Axe, then Malefic Roar and Blade of Despair. Copy that core while you learn, so losses teach you about play, not items.

Spin first, then Kaerazu. Infernal Torrent immobilizes for 0.8 seconds after the first dash, and that window is short, so cast Kaerazu immediately so its delayed hit lands while the target is held. If you spin and then decide, the target is free before the hit arrives.

Make Falling Maple your dodge. You are untargetable for up to 1 second, so a targeted skill or projectile cast at you as you enter it misses. You are also immobilized in one spot, so leave early with the second Meisen-e dash rather than standing in area damage when the state ends.

Gank side lanes where the target is alone. Her full budget kills one squishy hero away from help, and it does not kill a tank or a carry standing next to two allies. Ask before you go: if I spend everything, does it die, and can I leave?

Let Energy come back between fights. Energy refills on the same timer as Meisen-e, and using a combo interrupts the refill. After a fight, farm with the base skills and let both come back together, so the next fight starts from a full budget.

Hunter Strike gives 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds after five hits in a row on the same target (8-second cooldown). Her dashes and combo hits add up quickly, so the speed often arrives mid-chase; use it to catch a fleeing target or to leave.

Turn picks into the Turtle. Her damage is front-loaded, so she is at her most dangerous early; a kill near the Turtle pit right before it spawns is the cleanest way to cash that in. Ping the objective before you gank, so your laners walk with you.

Respect the listed counters. In Mythical Glory+ the official site lists Yin, Hanzo, X.Borg, Alpha and Joy as heroes that counter Hirara. When one of them is on the enemy team, wait on the flank until their key skill is spent and fight with full Energy.

Enter teamfights late. Hirara has no frontline tools, so wait while the frontlines collide and the enemy tank or support uses their control on someone else. Then enter on the out-of-position carry or mage; Blade of Despair raises your Physical Attack by 25% for 2 seconds when you hit an enemy below half HP, so a target already damaged by your team is the one to finish.

In pro data the talents were almost always Thrill, Seasoned Hunter and Killing Spree (Assassin emblem). Seasoned Hunter adds 15% damage to Turtle and Lord, which matters on a hero who is meant to win objectives, and Killing Spree's heal and speed after hitting a low target chains you into the next one.

Bait before you commit. Against a hero whose answer is one targeted control skill, poke with Kaerazu to draw it out, then cast Falling Maple as it comes. Their answer misses, and you still hold your second Energy for Infernal Torrent.

Plan the exit before the entry. A full engage that locks, bursts and leaves uses both Energy and both dashes, so you fight once and then wait. Pick the angle so the second dash takes you toward your team or a wall, not deeper into theirs.

Use Falling Maple's untargetable window for objective steals. With Retribution, its delayed burst can take a Turtle or Lord at the last moment, and the untargetable state protects you from a single targeted answer while you do it.

Review your deaths for fights started with one Energy and no second dash. At this level they are choices. Also check how many kills turned into an objective within the next minute; that number shows whether your early lead is reaching the map.
